key_logic_flow: ResearchArena是一个轻量级框架，让Claude Code（Opus 4.6）、Codex（GPT-5.4）和Kimi Code（K2.5）三种AI智能体自主完成从构思、实验到论文撰写的完整研究循环。
在仅审查论文文本的SAR评估中，Claude Code得分最高，超过Analemma的FARS系统，并接近ICLR 2025人类投稿的加权平均分。
人工审查发现SAR评分与真实质量严重脱节：它奖励表面合理的论述框架，却无法验证实验实质内容。
在同时审查工作区和论文的PR评估中，所有智能体得分大幅下降，实验严谨性被确认为核心瓶颈。
三种智能体表现出三种失败模式（结果造假、实验效力不足、计划与执行脱节），且差异悬殊：Codex的论文章节与工件不匹配率和虚假引用率仅5%/8%，而Kimi Code高达77%/72%。
全部117篇AI生成论文均未达到顶级学术会议的接收标准，表明真正的自动化研究仍有显著差距。

articles.title: Open-World Evaluations for Measuring Frontier AI Capabilities
author: [[Sayash Kapoor, Peter Kirgis, Andrew Schwartz, Stephan Rabanser, J. J. Allaire, Rishi Bommasani, Harry Coppock, Magda Dubois, Gillian K Hadfield, Andrew B. Hall, Sara Hooker, Seth Lazar, Steve Newman, Dimitris Papailiopoulos, Shoshannah Tekofsky, Helen Toner, Cozmin Ududec, Arvind Narayanan]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmark-based evaluation remains important for tracking frontier AI progress. But it can both overstate and understate deployed capability because it privileges tasks that can be precisely specified, automatically graded, easy to optimize for, and run with low budgets and short time horizons. We advocate for a complementary class of evaluations, which we term open-world evaluations: long-horizon, messy, real-world tasks assessed through small-sample qualitative analysis rather than benchmark-scale automation. In this paper we survey recent open-world evaluations, identify their strengths and limitations, and introduce CRUX (Collaborative Research for Updating AI eXpectations), a project for conducting such evaluations regularly. As a first instance, we task an AI agent with developing and publishing a simple iOS application to the Apple App Store. The agent completed the task with only a single avoidable manual intervention, suggesting that open-world evaluations can provide early warning of capabilities that may soon become widespread. We conclude with recommendations for designing and reporting open-world evals.
articles.tldr: 论文提出开放世界评估作为基准测试的补充方法，并演示AI代理自主完成iOS应用上架
articles.objective_summary: arXiv上发表的一篇学术论文，研究者提出开放世界评估（open-world evaluations）作为传统基准测试的补充方法，通过小样本定性分析而非大规模自动化来评估长周期、混乱的真实世界任务。论文介绍了CRUX项目，并首次演示了一个AI代理自主开发并将iOS应用发布到苹果App Store，
key_logic_flow: 论文指出传统基准测试存在局限性：偏向可精确指定、自动评分、易于优化的任务，且运行预算低、时间跨度短，因此可能高估或低估实际部署能力。
论文提出开放世界评估作为补充方案，其特点是长周期、混乱的真实世界任务，通过小样本定性分析而非大规模自动化来评估。
论文介绍了CRUX（Collaborative Research for Updating AI eXpectations）项目，旨在定期开展开放世界评估。
首次演示中，AI代理被要求自主开发并将一个简单的iOS应用发布到苹果App Store，全程仅需一次可避免的人工干预即完成任务。
论文认为开放世界评估能够提供早期预警，提示那些可能很快变得普遍的能力。
论文最后给出了设计和报告开放世界评估的具体建议。

articles.title: AgentAtlas: Beyond Outcome Leaderboards for LLM Agents
author: [[Parsa Mazaheri, Kasra Mazaheri]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model agents now act on codebases, browsers, operating systems, calendars, files, and tool ecosystems, but the benchmarks used to evaluate them are fragmented: each emphasizes a different unit of measurement (final task success, tool-call validity, repeated-pass consistency, trajectory safety, or attack robustness). A line of 2024-2025 work has converged on the diagnosis that a single accuracy column is no longer the right unit of comparison for deployable agents. AgentAtlas extends this line of work with four components: (i) a six-state control-decision taxonomy (Act / Ask / Refuse / Stop / Confirm / Recover); (ii) a nine-category trajectory-failure taxonomy with two orthogonal hierarchical labels (primary_error_source, impact); (iii) a taxonomy-aware vs. taxonomy-blind methodology that measures how much of a model's apparent capability comes from the supervision in the prompt; and (iv) a benchmark-coverage audit mapping fifteen agent benchmarks against six behavioral axes. To demonstrate the methodology we run a small fixed eight-model set (1,342 generated items, four frontier closed and four open-weight) under both prompt modes. Removing the explicit label menu drops every model's trajectory accuracy by 14-40 pp to a tight 0.54-0.62 floor regardless of family, and no single model wins on all three of control accuracy, trajectory diagnosis, and tool-context utility retention. We treat the synthetic run as a measurement-protocol demonstration, not a benchmark release.
articles.tldr: AgentAtlas 提出超越准确率的 LLM 智能体评估框架，含六状态决策分类和九类轨迹失败分类法
articles.objective_summary: 该论文提出 AgentAtlas 评估框架，包含六状态控制决策分类法、九类轨迹失败分类法、分类感知与盲测对比方法及基准覆盖审计四个组件。在 8 个模型（4 闭源+4 开源）、1342 个样本上的实验显示，移除显式标签菜单后所有模型轨迹准确率下降 14-40 个百分点，收敛至 0.54-0.
key_logic_flow: 现有 LLM 智能体基准测试存在碎片化问题，各自侧重不同评估维度（任务成功率、工具调用有效性、一致通过率、轨迹安全性、攻击鲁棒性），单一准确率指标不足以衡量可部署智能体。
AgentAtlas 提出四组件评估框架：六状态控制决策分类法（Act/Ask/Refuse/Stop/Confirm/Recover）、九类轨迹失败分类法（含 primary_error_source 和 impact 两个正交层级标签）、分类感知与分类盲测对比方法、以及 15 个智能体基准对六大行为轴的覆盖审计。
在 8 个模型（4 个前沿闭源模型 + 4 个开源模型）共 1342 个样本上进行了两种提示模式的对比实验。
移除显式标签菜单后，所有模型的轨迹准确率下降 14-40 个百分点，收敛至 0.54-0.62 的狭窄区间，无论模型所属系列如何。
没有单一模型在控制准确性、轨迹诊断和工具上下文效用保持三个维度上同时获胜。
该研究的实验被视为测量协议的演示，而非正式基准发布。

articles.title: From Automated to Autonomous: Hierarchical Agent-native Network Architecture (HANA)
author: [[Binghan Wu, Shoufeng Wang, Yunxin Liu, Ya-Qin Zhang, Joseph Sifakis, Ye Ouyang]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20608v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Realizing Level 4/5 Autonomous Networks (AN) demands a shift from static automation to agent-native intelligence. Current operations, reliant on rigid scripts, lack the cognitive agency to handle off-nominal conditions. To address this, this letter proposes a hierarchical multi-agent reference architecture enabling high-level autonomy. The framework features a Dual-Driven Orchestrator that coordinates specialized Executive Agents, supported by a shared Public Memory for unified domain knowledge. A key innovation is the integration of agent self-awareness, which empowers the system to harmonize deliberative strategic governance with reflexive fault recovery. We instantiate and validate this architecture within a 5G Core environment. Case studies demonstrate that the system sustains critical throughput under congestion and reduces Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) by 86%, confirming its efficacy in unifying strategic planning with operational resilience.
articles.tldr: HANA 分层多智能体架构使网络自治，5G 核心网验证 MTTR 减少 86%
articles.objective_summary: arXiv 论文提出 HANA（分层智能体原生网络架构），包含双驱动编排器、专用执行智能体和共享公共记忆三个核心组件，通过智能体自我意识统一策略治理与故障恢复机制。在 5G 核心网环境中验证，拥堵下维持关键吞吐量，MTTR 降低 86%。
key_logic_flow: 现有网络运维依赖静态脚本，缺乏处理异常工况的认知能力，无法实现 L4/L5 自治网络。
论文提出 HANA（Hierarchical Agent-native Network Architecture）分层智能体原生网络架构作为解决方案。
架构核心包括三个组件：双驱动编排器（Dual-Driven Orchestrator）负责协调、专用执行智能体（Executive Agents）执行任务、共享公共记忆（Public Memory）统一领域知识。
核心创新在于集成智能体自我意识（agent self-awareness），实现审慎性策略治理与反射性故障恢复的协调统一。
在 5G 核心网环境中完成实例化部署与验证，拥堵场景下系统仍能维持关键吞吐量。
实验表明该架构使平均修复时间（MTTR）降低 86%，证明其在统一战略规划与运维韧性方面的有效性。

articles.title: Discoverable Agent Knowledge -- A Formal Framework for Agentic KG Affordances (Extended Version)
author: [[Terry R. Payne, Valentina Tamma, Enrico Daga]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.19186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two decades ago, the Semantic Web Services community was asked how agents with different ontological commitments could discover, compose, and invoke web services coherently. The response was OWL-S and WSMO: formally grounded capability descriptions specifying what a service could do, what the agent must already know for invocation to be epistemically sound, and how ontological mismatches could be formally bridged. Current Knowledge Graph (KG) metadata standards such as VoID and DCAT describe what a KG contains yet say nothing about what a specific agent can prove from it, what closure assumptions govern empty results, or whether the agent's task vocabulary is grounded in the schema. Furthermore, in deployed KGs the governing schema DL and the operative entailment regime can diverge: an epistemic failure mode invisible to current metadata. We revisit and extend these insights for the KG setting with a four-dimensional formal framework from which we derive the Agentic Affordance Profile (AAP): a semantic layer above VoID and DCAT enabling principled KG selection, composition, and failure diagnosis at agent planning time. A five-point research agenda identifies the formal, computational, and engineering work needed to realise AAP-based affordance matching at scale.
articles.tldr: 论文提出Agentic Affordance Profile框架，使知识图谱对AI代理可发现、可组合
articles.objective_summary: arXiv上发表的计算机科学论文，借鉴OWL-S和WSMO的语义网服务思路，提出四维形式化框架AAP作为VoID和DCAT之上的语义层，使知识图谱对AI代理可发现、可组合、可故障诊断，并列出五点后续研究议程。
key_logic_flow: 二十年前语义网服务社区提出OWL-S和WSMO，解决具有不同本体承诺的代理如何发现、组合和调用Web服务的问题。
当前KG元数据标准（VoID、DCAT）仅描述知识图谱包含什么，不说明代理能从其中证明什么、空结果的闭包假设、或任务词汇是否与模式对齐。
已部署的KG中，模式描述逻辑与运行时推理机制可能不一致，形成当前元数据无法捕捉的认知失败模式。
论文提出四维形式化框架，从中推导出Agentic Affordance Profile（AAP）作为VoID和DCAT之上的语义层。
AAP支持代理在规划时进行原则性的KG选择、组合和故障诊断。
论文列出五点研究议程，涵盖AAP大规模能力匹配所需的形式化、计算和工程工作。

articles.title: Learning to Hand Off: Provably Convergent Workflow Learning under Interface Constraints
author: [[Jiayu Li, Enpei Zhang, Dawei Zhou, Elynn Chen, Yujun Yan]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.19140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study workflow learning in a setting where specialized agents hand off control through a shared artifact, each agent observes only a local function of that artifact and its own private state, and no centralized learner accesses joint trajectories -- the operating regime of multi-agent LLM pipelines that span organizational, vendor, or trust boundaries. We formalize this regime as an interface-constrained semi-Markov decision process (IC-SMDP), whose decision epochs occur at handoff times, and design IC-$Q$, an asynchronous decentralized $Q$-learning algorithm in which cross-agent coordination at every handoff is exactly one scalar. Our main result is a finite-sample bound for neural IC-$Q$ that decomposes into three independently controllable error sources: neural function-approximation error, interface representation gap, and a mixing-time residual, under the random option-duration discount. Establishing this bound requires lifting the approximate information state (AIS) framework from single-agent primitive-step MDPs to multi-agent SMDPs and controlling Markovian noise under random duration, neither of which has been done in prior work. To our knowledge this is the first finite-sample guarantee for neural $Q$-learning under decentralized partial observability. Four experiments: a controlled synthetic IC-SMDP that validates the bound term-by-term, multi-LLM mathematical reasoning, multi-agent routing, and multi-agent CPU programming, show that IC-$Q$ matches a centralized oracle without any agent observing joint trajectories, with each of the three error sources scaling along its corresponding axis as the bound predicts.
articles.tldr: 提出IC-Q算法，实现去中心化异步Q学习，并证明其有限样本收敛保证
articles.objective_summary: 该论文正式定义了接口约束半马尔可夫决策过程（IC-SMDP），并提出IC-Q去中心化异步Q学习算法。该算法在智能体交接时仅传递一个标量值进行协调，无需任何智能体观察联合轨迹。论文推导了神经IC-Q的有限样本界，并通过四项实验验证了理论结果。
key_logic_flow: 论文定义了接口约束半马尔可夫决策过程（IC-SMDP），其中专业化智能体通过共享工件进行控制交接，每个智能体仅能观察工件的局部函数及其自身私有状态。
论文提出IC-Q去中心化异步Q学习算法，在每次智能体交接时仅传递一个标量值进行跨智能体协调，无需集中式学习器或联合轨迹。
论文的核心理论贡献是推导了神经IC-Q的有限样本界，该界分解为三个独立可控的误差源：神经函数逼近误差、接口表示间隙和混合时间残差。
理论证明将近似信息状态（AIS）框架从单智能体基本步MDP首次推广到多智能体SMDP，并控制了随机持续时间下的马尔可夫噪声。
四项实验（合成IC-SMDP验证、多LLM数学推理、多智能体路由、多智能体CPU编程）表明IC-Q达到集中式oracle性能，且三个误差源按理论预测方向独立缩放。

articles.title: Declarative Data Services: Structured Agentic Discovery for Composing Data Systems
author: [[Shanshan Ye, Duo Lu]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20690v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic discovery has shown that LLM-driven search can find novel algorithms, designs, and code under benchmark conditions. Translating the paradigm to multi-system data backends surfaces a harder problem: the search space is heterogeneous, the verifier is whether a deployed stack actually runs, and composition knowledge is unevenly captured in pretraining. Unbounded agentic discovery, a coding agent iterating on failure-log feedback, fails to converge consistently on a working stack even when iteration and explicit composition knowledge are added. We propose Declarative Data Services (DDS), an architecture for structured agentic discovery of data-system compositions from declarative user intent. The framework owns four typed contracts at successive layers (intent, operator DAG, per-system skills, runtime attribution) that decompose the global search into bounded sub-searches; sub-agents search each typed space, while the framework provides the channels by which knowledge flows forward as inline skill citations and errors route backward as typed signals. As a proof of life on a trading-backend workload, DDS converges where unbounded discovery does not; runtime failures become skill patches that the next deployment cites inline. We position this as an early prototype reporting lessons from real-world data-system composition.
articles.tldr: 提出声明式数据服务(DDS)架构，用结构化智能体发现替代无界发现，在交易后端工作负载上验证收敛性。
articles.objective_summary: arXiv 论文提出 Declarative Data Services (DDS) 架构，通过四层类型化契约（意图→算子DAG→系统技能→运行时归因）将数据系统组合的全局搜索分解为有界子搜索。在交易后端工作负载上，DDS 收敛至可用栈，而无界智能体发现无法一致收敛。
key_logic_flow: 无界智能体发现（编码智能体基于失败日志反馈迭代）在多系统数据后端组合中无法一致收敛到可运行的栈。
DDS 架构定义了四层类型化契约：意图层、算子 DAG 层、系统技能层和运行时归因层，将全局搜索拆解为有界子搜索。
子智能体各自搜索类型化空间，框架提供前向知识流（内联技能引用）和后向错误路由（类型化信号）的通道。
在交易后端工作负载测试中，DDS 成功收敛到可运行栈，而无界发现无法收敛。
运行时失败被转化为技能补丁，由下一次部署内联引用，形成持续改进循环。

articles.title: SOLAR: A Self-Optimizing Open-Ended Autonomous Agent for Lifelong Learning and Continual Adaptation
author: [[Nitin Vetcha, Dianbo Liu]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite the remarkable success of large language models (LLMs), they still face bottlenecks while deploying in dynamic, real-world settings with primary challenges being concept drift and the high cost of gradient-based adaptation. Traditional fine-tuning (FT) struggles to adapt to non-stationary data streams without resulting in catastrophic for getting or requiring extensive manual data curation. To address these limitations within the streaming and continual learning paradigm, we propose the Self-Optimizing Lifelong Autonomous Reasoner (SOLAR) which is an open-ended autonomous agent that leverages parameter-level meta-learning to self-improve, treating model weights as an environment for exploration. It initiates the process by consolidating a strong prior over common-sense knowledge making it effective for transfer-learning. By utilizing a multi-level reinforcement learning approach, SOLAR autonomously discovers adaptation strategies, enabling efficient test-time adaptation to unseen domains. Crucially, SOLAR maintains an evolving knowledge base of valid modification strategies, implicitly acting as an episodic memory buffer to balance plasticity (adaptation to new tasks) and stability (retention of meta-knowledge). Experiments demonstrate that SOLAR outperforms strong baselines on common-sense, mathematical, medical, coding, social and logical reasoning tasks, marking a significant step toward autonomous agents capable of lifelong adaptation in evolving environments.
articles.tldr: arXiv论文提出SOLAR自主智能体，通过参数级元学习和多级强化学习实现终身持续适应，无需梯度更新。
articles.objective_summary: 论文提出SOLAR（自优化终身自主推理器），一种将模型权重视为探索环境的自主智能体。它采用参数级元学习和多级强化学习，自主发现适应策略，实现无需梯度更新的测试时域适应。在常识、数学、医疗、编程、社会和逻辑推理任务上均优于强基线方法。
key_logic_flow: 论文提出SOLAR（Self-Optimizing Lifelong Autonomous Reasoner），一种面向终身学习和持续适应的开放式自主智能体架构。
SOLAR的核心创新是将模型权重视为可探索的环境，通过参数级元学习实现无需梯度更新的自我优化。
该智能体采用多级强化学习方法，在测试阶段自主发现并执行适应策略，实现对未见领域的高效适应。
SOLAR维护一个持续演化的修改策略知识库，作为情景记忆缓冲区，平衡对新任务的可塑性和对元知识的稳定性。
实验评估覆盖常识推理、数学、医疗、编程、社会和逻辑推理六大任务，SOLAR在所有任务上均超越强基线方法。

articles.title: Position: Let's Develop Data Probes to Fundamentally Understand How Data Affects LLM Performance
author: [[Shiqiang Wang, Herbert Woisetschl\"ager, Hans Arno Jacobsen, Mingyue Ji]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.18801v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data is fundamental to large language models (LLMs). However, understanding of what makes certain data useful for different stages of an LLM workflow, including training, tuning, alignment, in-context learning, etc., and why, remains an open question. Current approaches rely heavily on extensive experimentation with large public datasets to obtain empirical heuristics for data filtering and dataset construction. These approaches are compute intensive and lack a principled way of understanding the essence of how specific data characteristics drive LLM behavior. In this position paper, we advocate for the need of developing systematic methodologies for generating synthetic sequences from appropriately defined random processes, with the goal that these sequences can reveal useful characteristics when they are used in one or multiple stages of the LLM workflow. We refer to such sequences as data probes. By observing LLM behavior on data probes, researchers can systematically conduct studies on how data characteristics influence model performance, generalization, and robustness. The probing sequences exhibit statistical properties that can be viewed using theoretical concepts, such as typical sets, which are generalized to describe the behaviors of LLMs. This data-probe approach provides a pathway for uncovering foundational insights into the role of data in LLM training and inference, beyond empirical heuristics.
articles.tldr: 提出开发数据探针方法来系统研究数据特征对LLM性能的影响
articles.objective_summary: arXiv 一篇立场论文提出数据探针方法，通过从随机过程生成合成序列并观察LLM行为，系统研究数据特征如何影响模型在训练、微调、对齐等阶段的性能和泛化，旨在超越当前依赖经验启发式的做法。
key_logic_flow: 数据对LLM至关重要，但当前理解数据在不同阶段（训练、微调、对齐、上下文学习等）中发挥作用的原因和机制仍是一个开放问题。
现有方法依赖大规模公共数据集的广泛实验来获取数据过滤和数据集构建的经验启发式规则，计算密集且缺乏原则性理解。
该论文主张开发系统方法论，通过从适当定义的随机过程生成合成序列来揭示数据特征对LLM行为的影响。
这些合成序列被称为数据探针，通过观察LLM在探针上的行为，可以系统研究数据特征如何影响模型性能、泛化和鲁棒性。
探针序列的统计特性可以用典型集等理论概念来描述，这些概念被推广用以描述LLM的行为规律。
数据探针方法为理解数据在LLM训练和推理中的基础性作用提供了一条超越经验启发式规则的新路径。

articles.title: Trustworthy Agent Network: Trust in Agent Networks Must Be Baked In, Not Bolted On
author: [[Yixiang Yao, Yuhang Yao, Xinyi Fan, Jiechao Gao, Jie Wang, Minjia Zhang, Srivatsan Ravi, Carlee Joe-Wong]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.19035v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models has given rise to autonomous LLM-based agents capable of complex reasoning and execution. As these agents transition from isolated operation to collaborative ecosystems, we witness the emergence of the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) network, a paradigm where heterogeneous agents autonomously coordinate to solve multi-step tasks. While these networks may offer better task performance compared to simply using one agent to complete the entire task, they introduce systemic vulnerabilities, such as adversarial composition, semantic misalignment, and cascading operational failures, that existing agent alignment techniques cannot address. In this vision paper, we argue that the trustworthiness of A2A networks cannot be fully guaranteed via retrofitting on existing protocols that are largely designed for individual agents. Rather, it must be architected from the very beginning of the A2A coordination framework. We present a comprehensive conceptual framework that situates trust in A2A systems through four design pillars.
articles.tldr: 观点论文：A2A网络可信必须从架构设计之初内建，而非事后修补
articles.objective_summary: arXiv上发表的观点论文，指出LLM驱动的自主智能体从独立运行转向协作生态（A2A网络）时，面临对抗性组合、语义错位和级联故障等系统性漏洞，认为现有单体智能体对齐技术无法解决，主张可信必须从A2A协调框架设计之初就内建，并提出了四个设计支柱的概念框架。
key_logic_flow: LLM驱动的自主智能体已具备复杂推理和执行能力，正从独立运行转向协作生态。
A2A（Agent-to-Agent）网络是异构智能体自主协调解决多步骤任务的新范式。
A2A网络虽可能比单智能体完成任务表现更好，但引入对抗性组合、语义错位和级联故障三类系统性漏洞。
现有智能体对齐技术针对单体智能体设计，无法解决A2A网络的系统性安全漏洞。
论文主张A2A网络可信不能事后在现有协议上打补丁，必须从协调框架设计之初就内建可信机制。
论文提出了一个通过四个设计支柱来构建A2A系统可信性的概念框架。

articles.title: AgentCo-op: Retrieval-Based Synthesis of Interoperable Multi-Agent Workflows
author: [[Shuaike Shen, Wenduo Cheng, Shike Wang, Mingqian Ma, Jian Ma]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing multi-agent workflows is especially difficult in open-ended scientific settings where tasks lack curated training sets, reliable scalar evaluation metrics, and standardized interfaces between existing tools and agents. We propose AgentCo-op, a retrieval-based synthesis framework that composes reusable skills, tools, and external agents into executable workflows through typed artifact handoffs, then applies bounded self-guided local repair to implicated components when execution evidence indicates failure. In two open-world genomics case studies, AgentCo-op composes independently developed scientific agents and external tool repositories into auditable workflows without redesigning them or running global topology search. It coordinates specialized agents for spatial transcriptomics and gene-set interpretation to enable collaborative discovery from spatial transcriptomics data, and builds a parallel workflow for cross-modality marker analysis on single-cell multiome data. AgentCo-op can also import a searched workflow as a structural prior and improve it by grounding nodes with retrieved components and applying local repair, showing that synthesis and search are complementary. On six coding, math, and question-answering benchmarks, AgentCo-op achieves the best result on four benchmarks and the best average score under a unified backbone setting, while consistently reducing per-task cost relative to multi-agent baselines. Together, these results suggest that retrieval-based synthesis can extend automated agentic workflow design beyond benchmark-optimized agent graphs to open-world workflows built from existing agents, tools, and typed artifacts.
articles.tldr: AgentCo-op 提出基于检索的多智能体工作流合成框架，通过类型化工件传递组合现有工具和智能体。
articles.objective_summary: arXiv 上发表学术论文，提出 AgentCo-op 框架，通过检索式合成将技能、工具和外部智能体组合为可执行多智能体工作流，在基因组学和六个基准测试中验证了有效性。
key_logic_flow: AgentCo-op 提出基于检索的合成框架，通过类型化工件传递将可复用的技能、工具和外部智能体组合成可执行的多智能体工作流。
当执行证据表明失败时，AgentCo-op 对相关组件执行有限的自引导局部修复，无需全局拓扑搜索或重新设计。
在空间转录组学和基因集解读两个开放世界基因组学案例中，AgentCo-op 成功协调了独立开发的科学智能体和外部工具仓库，无需重新设计它们。
AgentCo-op 可以将搜索到的工作流作为结构先验导入，通过检索组件落地节点并应用局部修复来改进工作流，表明合成与搜索是互补的。
在六个编程、数学和问答基准测试中，AgentCo-op 在统一主干设置下获得四项最佳结果和最佳平均分数，同时持续降低了每个任务的成本。

articles.title: Evaluating the Utility of Personal Health Records in Personalized Health AI
author: [[Rory Sayres, Kejia Chen, Ayush Jain, Matthew Thompson, Jonathan Richina, Xiang Yin, Jimmy Hu, Fan Zhang, Bob Lou, Mike Sanchez, Ines Mezerreg, Meredith Schreier, Hamsa Subramaniam, I-Ching Lee, Yugang Jia, Daniel Mcduff, Yossi Matias, Avinatan Hassidim, Dale Webster, Yun Liu, Jackie Barr, Quang Duong]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.18937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Patient-managed Personal Health Records (PHRs) promises to empower patients to better understand their health; but information in the record is complex, potentially hindering insights. In this study, we assess the potential of large language models (LLMs, Gemini 3.0 Flash) to provide helpful answers to user health queries, when provided clinical data from PHRs as context. A total of 2,257 user queries were drawn from 3 different distributions to represent patient questions: shorter web search queries, longer questions derived from templates of chatbot conversations, and questions patients asked to their healthcare team (patient calls). Queries were matched with de-identified PHRs (from a pool of 1,945). Gemini responses were generated (1) without PHR context; (2) with a basic summary of demographics, conditions, and medications; (3) with full, extensive clinical notes. For evaluation, we leveraged an existing rating framework (SHARP), and developed a new framework for specific error modes when interpreting PHRs. Evaluation was performed using autoraters for the full set, and with clinician ratings for a subset (n=95), with both sets of raters knowing the full PHR context. We see significant improvements in the helpfulness of answers to all question types with PHR data (p < 0.001, paired t-test). We also observe potential gains in safety, accuracy, relevance and personalization of answers. Our PHR evaluation framework further identifies gaps in LLM understanding of particular aspects of complex PHRs, such as temporal disorientation, and rare but meaningful confabulations. These results suggest potential for PHR data to help people with a wide range of user needs; and provide a framework for monitoring for gaps in LLM answers based on PHR context. This study motivates further work to assess and realize potential benefits to users from understanding their health records.
articles.tldr: 研究评估LLM结合个人健康记录回答健康查询的效果，发现PHR数据显著提升回答质量。
articles.objective_summary: 该研究使用2,257条用户查询和1,945份去标识化个人健康记录，评估Gemini 3.0 Flash在有无PHR上下文下回答健康问题的效果。结果显示，加入PHR数据后回答帮助性显著提升（p<0.001），同时发现模型存在时间方向混淆和罕见但严重的幻觉问题。
key_logic_flow: 研究收集了2,257条来自三种分布（短网页搜索查询、模板化聊天机器人问题、患者向医疗团队提问）的用户健康查询，匹配了1,945份去标识化的个人健康记录。
使用Gemini 3.0 Flash在三种条件下生成回答：无PHR上下文、基础摘要（人口统计+病症+用药）、完整临床笔记。
采用SHARP评估框架以及新开发的PHR错误模式评估框架，通过自动评估器和临床医生子集评分（n=95）进行评价。
加入PHR数据后，所有类型查询的回答帮助性均显著提升（p<0.001，配对t检验），在安全性、准确性、相关性和个性化方面也观察到潜在改进。
PHR评估框架识别出LLM对复杂个人健康记录理解的特定缺陷，包括时间方向混淆和罕见但有意义的幻觉。

articles.title: Evaluating Temporal Semantic Caching and Workflow Optimization in Agentic Plan-Execute Pipelines
author: [[Alimurtaza Mustafa Merchant, Krish Veera, Sajal Kumar Goyla, Shambhawi Bhure, Dhaval Patel, Kaoutar El Maghraoui]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20630v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Industrial asset operations workflows are latency-sensitive because a single user query may require coordination over sensor data, work orders, failure modes, forecasting tools, and domain-specific agents. We evaluate this problem on AssetOpsBench (AOB), an industrial agent benchmark whose plan-execute pipeline exposes repeated overhead from tool discovery, LLM planning, MCP tool execution, and final summarization. Existing LLM caching techniques such as KV-cache reuse and embedding-based semantic caching were designed for chatbot serving and break down when output validity depends on time, asset, or sensor parameters. We propose two complementary optimization layers for AOB plan-execute pipelines: a temporal semantic cache and a set of MCP workflow optimizations combining disk-backed tool-discovery caching and dependency-aware parallel step execution. MCP workflow optimizations corresponded to a 1.67x speedup and reduced median end-to-end latency by about 40.0% while the temporal-cache benchmark achieved a median of 30.6x speedup on cache hits. Beyond the speedup, our results expose a concrete failure mode of pure semantic caching for parameter-rich industrial queries, providing a critical analysis of how caching choices interact with evaluation correctness in MCP-backed agent benchmarks.
articles.tldr: 针对工业AI agent流水线，提出时序语义缓存+MCP工作流优化，分别实现30.6倍和1.67倍加速。
articles.objective_summary: 该论文针对工业资产运维场景下的Agent Plan-Execute流水线延迟问题，提出基于时序语义缓存和MCP工作流优化（磁盘缓存+依赖感知并行执行）两种互补方案。在AssetOpsBench基准上，MCP优化带来1.67倍加速、中位延迟降低约40%；时序缓存命中时中位加速达30.6倍。
key_logic_flow: 工业资产运维场景中的单次用户查询需要协调传感器数据、工单、故障模式、预测工具和领域Agent，导致Plan-Execute流水线存在大量重复开销。
现有LLM缓存技术（如KV-cache复用、基于嵌入的语义缓存）面向聊天场景设计，在输出有效性依赖时间、资产或传感器参数的工业查询中效果不佳。
论文提出两层互补优化：一是时序语义缓存，考虑时间维度有效性；二是MCP工作流优化，包括基于磁盘的工具发现缓存和依赖感知的并行步骤执行。
MCP工作流优化实现1.67倍加速，中位端到端延迟降低约40%；时序语义缓存在命中时实现中位30.6倍加速。
实验结果揭示了纯语义缓存在参数丰富的工业查询中的具体失效模式，分析了缓存选择如何影响MCP-backed Agent基准评测的正确性。

articles.title: Personality Engineering with AI Agents: A New Methodology for Negotiation Research
author: [[Michelle A. Vaccaro, Jared R. Curhan]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20554v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: According to canonical negotiation theory, people's success in a negotiation depends on how well they balance competing demands--empathizing and asserting, demonstrating concern for other and concern for self, being soft on the people and hard on the problem. Yet people struggle to manage these tensions, so researchers have lacked the ability to rigorously test the field's prescriptions under controlled conditions. AI agents do not face the same limitations, and their precision, repertoire, consistency, and scalability enable a new class of experiments to contribute to negotiation theory. In this article, we introduce personality engineering: a methodology that uses AI agents to precisely parameterize, manipulate, and evaluate negotiator personality. We propose using the interpersonal circumplex--and its two core dimensions of warmth and dominance--as a foundational coordinate system for the field. This approach offers both a rigorous methodology for testing classic negotiation theories and a practical guide for designing the personalities of AI negotiation agents.
articles.tldr: 论文提出"人格工程"方法论，用AI代理精确操控谈判者人格以检验谈判理论。
articles.objective_summary: 该论文提出人格工程（personality engineering）方法论，利用AI代理对谈判者人格进行精确参数化、操纵和评估。论文提议将人际圆周模型（interpersonal circumplex）的温暖（warmth）和支配性（dominance）两个核心维度作为谈判研究的坐标系统，
key_logic_flow: 传统谈判理论认为谈判成功取决于平衡共情与主张、关心他人与关心自我等多重矛盾需求，但人类在管理这些张力方面存在固有困难。
研究者因人类局限而难以在受控条件下严格检验谈判理论的指导原则，AI代理以其精准性、一致性、可扩展性和丰富行为库克服了这些局限。
论文提出了"人格工程"（personality engineering）方法论，利用AI代理对谈判者人格进行精确参数化、操纵和评估，以推动谈判理论研究。
论文提议将人际圆周模型（interpersonal circumplex）及其温暖（warmth）和支配性（dominance）两个核心维度作为谈判研究的基础坐标系统。
该方法既为检验经典谈判理论提供了严格的受控实验手段，也为设计AI谈判代理的人格特征提供了实践指南。

articles.title: DecisionBench: A Benchmark for Emergent Delegation in Long-Horizon Agentic Workflows
author: [[Yuxuan Gao, Megan Wang, Yi Ling Yu, Zijian Carl Ma, Ao Qu]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.19099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce DecisionBench, a benchmark substrate for emergent delegation in long-horizon agentic workflows. The substrate fixes a task suite (GAIA, tau-bench, BFCL multi-turn), a peer-model pool (11 models, 7 vendor families), a delegation interface (call_model plus an optional read_profile channel), a deterministic skill-annotation layer, and a multi-axis metric suite covering quality, cost, latency, delegation rate, routing fidelity-at-k, vendor self-preference, and a counterfactual-delegation ceiling. The substrate is agnostic to how peer information is generated or delivered, so learned routers, richer peer memories, adaptive profile construction, and multi-step delegation can all be evaluated against it. We characterize the substrate with a five-condition reference sweep on the full pool (n=23,375 task instances). Three benchmark-level findings emerge: (i) mean end-task quality is statistically indistinguishable across the four awareness conditions (|beta| = 0.21), so quality-only evaluation would miss the orchestration signal; (ii) routing fidelity-at-1 ranges from 7.5% to 29.5% across conditions at near-equal mean quality, with delivery channel (on-demand tool vs. preloaded description) dominating description content; (iii) a counterfactual ceiling places perfect delegation 15-31 percentage points above measured performance on every suite, locating large unrealized headroom for future orchestration methods. We release the substrate, annotation layer, reference intervention suite, analysis pipeline, and 220 per-condition run archives.
articles.tldr: DecisionBench 提出评估多智能体长期委托协作能力的标准化基准框架
articles.objective_summary: 研究者在 arXiv 发布 DecisionBench 基准，用于评估长周期智能体工作流中的委托协作能力。该基准包含 GAIA、tau-bench、BFCL multi-turn 三个任务套件、11 个模型（来自 7 个供应商家族）和多项评估指标，在 23,375 个实例上完成参考扫描。
key_logic_flow: DecisionBench 是一个标准化基准框架，专门用于评估长周期智能体工作流中的委托协作能力，包含任务套件、模型池、委托接口、技能标注层和多维度评估指标。
框架包含三个任务套件（GAIA、tau-bench、BFCL multi-turn），11 个模型组成同伴模型池（来自 7 个供应商家族），委托接口为 call_model 加可选 read_profile 通道。
研究者在全部模型池上执行了五个条件的参考扫描，累计 23,375 个任务实例。
四种感知条件下的平均任务质量无统计学显著差异（|beta| <= 0.010, p >= 0.21），说明仅凭质量指标会遗漏委托编排信号。
Top-1 路由保真度在不同条件间从 7.5% 到 29.5% 不等，且交付通道（按需工具 vs. 预加载描述）对结果的影响远大于描述内容本身。
反事实天花板分析表明，完美委托相比当前实测性能还有 15 到 31 个百分点的未实现提升空间，表明未来的编排方法仍有很大潜力。

articles.title: AgentNLQ: A General-Purpose Agent for Natural Language to SQL
author: [[Olena Bogdanov, Yeunji Jung, Chandra Dhir, Pareekshitreddy Gaddam, Saurabh Jain, Lakshmi Tumati, Vijay Parthasarathy, Anup Shirgaonkar]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.19010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Natural language to SQL (NL2SQL) conversion is an important problem for researchers and enterprises due to the ubiquitous importance of relational databases in broad-ranging practical problems. Despite the rapid advancements in the capabilities of LLMs, NL2SQL has not reached parity in accuracy with human expert SQL writers, hence needing additional improvements in NL2SQL algorithms. This study presents a new multi-agent method for NL2SQL that achieves 78.1% semantic accuracy on the BIg Bench for LaRge-scale Database (BIRD) benchmark. Our method leverages a semantically enriched representation of user-provided schema, adds user-provided business rules, and produces accurate SQL queries. The main contributions of this study are (a) We designed an optimized new orchestrator in a multi-agent solution that uses LLMs to plan, orchestrate, reflect, and self-correct to generate accurate SQL queries, (b) We developed an advanced schema enrichment method that creates context-aware metadata to improve accuracy, and (c) We demonstrated the accuracy and generalizability of the method across different domains and datasets by evaluating it on the BIRD-SQL benchmark.
articles.tldr: 提出AgentNLQ多智能体NL2SQL方法，在BIRD基准上达78.1%语义准确率。
articles.objective_summary: 该论文提出AgentNLQ，一种基于多智能体架构的自然语言转SQL方法，利用LLM进行规划、编排、反思与自我修正，结合模式丰富技术增强上下文感知元数据，在BIRD基准上达到78.1%语义准确率。
key_logic_flow: 该论文提出一种名为AgentNLQ的多智能体NL2SQL方法，采用LLM作为核心驱动力来规划、编排、反思和自我修正SQL查询。
AgentNLQ通过语义丰富的模式增强方法创建上下文感知的元数据，并结合用户提供的业务规则来提升查询准确率。
在BIRD基准测试上，AgentNLQ达到了78.1%的语义准确率，尚未达到人类专家SQL编写者的水平。
该方法在不同领域和数据集上的准确性与泛化能力已通过BIRD-SQL基准评估得到验证。

articles.title: Progressive Autonomy as Preference Learning: A Formalization of Trust Calibration for Agentic Tool Use
author: [[Changkun Ou]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.19151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formalize trust calibration for agentic tool use (deciding when an automated agent's proposed action may execute autonomously versus require human approval) as a preference-learning problem. A policy gateway maintains a Gaussian-process posterior over a latent human risk-tolerance function, observed through a probit likelihood on binary approve/deny feedback, and escalates to the human exactly where the approval outcome is most uncertain. We show this is structurally an instance of Preferential Bayesian Optimization, inheriting its inference machinery (approximate Gaussian-process classification) and its sample-efficiency argument (uncertainty-targeted querying), while differing in objective: classifying an action space into allow/block/ask regions rather than optimizing a design.
articles.tldr: 将自主代理的信任校准形式化为偏好学习问题，使用高斯过程分类动作空间为允许/阻止/询问区域
articles.objective_summary: 该论文在arXiv上发表，将智能体工具使用的信任校准（决定何时自动执行、何时需人工批准）形式化为偏好学习问题。策略网关通过高斯过程后验推断人类风险容忍度，在不确定性最高时向人类升级审批，最终将动作空间分类为允许、阻止、询问三个区域。
key_logic_flow: 论文将智能体工具使用中的信任校准问题定义为偏好学习问题，核心决策是判断代理的提议动作应自动执行还是需要人类审批。
策略网关维护一个高斯过程后验分布，用于建模人类潜在的风险容忍度函数。
该模型通过probit似然函数对二元审批反馈（批准/拒绝）进行观测和更新。
系统在审批结果不确定性最高时将决策升级给人类，而非随机或固定阈值查询。
论文证明该框架本质上是偏好贝叶斯优化的一个实例，继承了其近似高斯过程分类的推理机制和不确定性导向查询的样本效率。
与传统偏好贝叶斯优化的区别在于目标：本框架是对动作空间进行分类（允许/阻止/询问），而非优化某个设计参数。

articles.title: Learn-by-Wire Training Control Governance: Bounded Autonomous Training Under Stress for Stability and Efficiency
author: [[Anis Radianis]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.19008v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern language-model training is increasingly exposed to instability, degraded runs, and wasted compute, especially under aggressive learning-rate, scale, and runtime-stress conditions. This paper introduces Learn-by-Wire Guard (LBW-Guard), a bounded autonomous training-control governance layer that operates above AdamW. Rather than replacing the optimizer update rule, LBW-Guard observes training telemetry, interprets instability-sensitive regimes, and applies bounded control to optimizer execution while preserving fixed training objectives. We evaluate LBW-Guard in a Qwen2.5-centered stress-and-robustness suite using WikiText-103, with Qwen2.5-7B as the empirical anchor, model-size comparisons against Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-14B, learning-rate stress tests, gradient-clipping baselines, and a no-LoRA TinyLlama-1B full-parameter sanity check. In the 7B reference setting, LBW-Guard reduces final perplexity from 13.21 to 10.74, an 18.7% improvement, while reducing end-to-end time from 392.54s to 357.02s, a 1.10x speedup. Under stronger learning-rate stress, AdamW degrades to 1885.24 final perplexity at LR=3e-3 and 659.76 at LR=1e-3, whereas LBW-Guard remains trainable at 11.57 and 10.33, respectively. Gradient-clipping baselines do not reproduce this effect. These results support a scoped systems conclusion that stability-sensitive LLM training can benefit from a governance plane above the optimizer. LBW-Guard provides evidence that bounded runtime control can preserve productive compute under stress while remaining distinct from optimizer replacement and local gradient suppression.
articles.tldr: 提出LBW-Guard，一种在AdamW之上的有界自主训练控制层，将Qwen2.5-7B困惑度从13.21降至10.74。
articles.objective_summary: 该论文提出Learn-by-Wire Guard（LBW-Guard），一种运行在AdamW优化器之上的有界自主训练控制治理层，通过监测训练遥测数据在不稳定时施加控制。在Qwen2.5-7B和WikiText-103上的实验显示，最终困惑度从13.21降至10.74（提升18.
key_logic_flow: LBW-Guard是一个位于AdamW优化器之上的有界自主训练控制治理层，不替换优化器，而是通过观测训练遥测数据在不稳定敏感区间施加有界控制。
在Qwen2.5-7B参考设置下，LBW-Guard将最终困惑度从13.21降至10.74（提升18.7%），端到端训练时间从392.54秒缩短至357.02秒（加速1.10倍）。
在高学习率压力测试中（LR=3e-3），AdamW退化至困惑度1885.24，而LBW-Guard保持可训练状态，困惑度仅为11.57。
梯度裁剪基线方法无法复现LBW-Guard的稳定性提升效果，表明其机制与局部梯度抑制不同。
实验覆盖了Qwen2.5-3B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-14B的模型规模对比以及TinyLlama-1B全参数训练验证。

articles.title: Mahjax: A GPU-Accelerated Mahjong Simulator for Reinforcement Learning in JAX
author: [[Soichiro Nishimori, Shinri Okano, Keigo Habara, Sotetsu Koyamada, Eason Yu, Masashi Sugiyama]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20577v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Riichi Mahjong is a multi-player, imperfect-information game characterized by stochasticity and high-dimensional state spaces. These attributes present a unique combination of challenges that mirror complex real-world decision-making problems in reinforcement learning. While prior research has heavily relied on supervised learning from human play logs to pre-train the policy, algorithms capable of learning \textit{tabula rasa} (from scratch) offer greater potential for general applicability, as evidenced by the AlphaZero lineage. To facilitate such research, we introduce \textbf{Mahjax}, a fully vectorized Riichi Mahjong environment implemented in JAX to enable large-scale rollout parallelization on Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). We also provide a high-quality visualization tool to streamline debugging and interaction with trained agents. Experimental results demonstrate that Mahjax achieves throughputs of up to \textbf{2 million} and \textbf{1 million steps per second} on eight NVIDIA A100 GPUs under the no-red and red rules, respectively. Furthermore, we validate the environment's utility for reinforcement learning by showing that agents can be trained effectively to improve their rank against baseline policies.
articles.tldr: 论文提出Mahjax，一个基于JAX的全矢量化日式麻将模拟器，可在GPU上实现大规模强化学习并行化。
articles.objective_summary: 该学术论文在arXiv上发表，介绍了一种名为Mahjax的GPU加速日式麻将（Riichi Mahjong）强化学习环境。该环境使用JAX实现全矢量化，支持在NVIDIA A100 GPU上大规模并行部署，在8块A100上最高达到每秒200万步的吞吐量，并提供了可视化工具。
key_logic_flow: 日式麻将是一种包含随机性和高维状态空间的多玩家不完全信息游戏，其复杂性反映了强化学习中现实决策问题的挑战。
Mahjax是一个基于JAX实现的全矢量化日式麻将模拟器，旨在利用GPU实现大规模rollout并行化。
该环境在8块NVIDIA A100 GPU上分别实现了无红牌规则下每秒200万步和有红牌规则下每秒100万步的吞吐量。
Mahjax附带高质量可视化工具，用于调试和与训练后的智能体交互。
实验证明，基于Mahjax训练的强化学习智能体能够有效提升其对基线策略的排名表现。

articles.title: High Quality Embeddings for Horn Logic Reasoning
author: [[Yifan Zhang, Yasir White, Dean Clark, Joseph Sanchez, Jevon Lipsey, Ashely Hirst, Jeff Heflin]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks can be trained to rank the choices made by logical reasoners, resulting in more efficient searches for answers. A key step in this process is creating useful embeddings, i.e., numeric representations of logical statements. This paper introduces and evaluates several approaches to creating embeddings that result in better downstream results. We train embeddings using triplet loss, which requires examples consisting of an anchor, a positive example, and a negative example. We introduce three ideas: generating anchors that are more likely to have repeated terms, generating positive and negative examples in a way that ensures a good balance between easy, medium, and hard examples, and periodically emphasizing the hardest examples during training. We conduct several experiments to evaluate this approach, including a comparison of different embeddings across different knowledge bases, in an attempt to identify what characteristics make an embedding well-suited to a particular reasoning task.
articles.tldr: 提出三种改进逻辑推理语句嵌入质量的方法，使用三元组损失训练提升下游排序效果。
articles.objective_summary: 该论文提出并评估了三种提升Horn逻辑推理中语句嵌入质量的方法：生成重复项更多的锚点、平衡正负样本难度分布、训练中周期性强调困难样本。实验跨多个知识库对比不同嵌入特征对推理任务的影响。
key_logic_flow: 论文目标是创建逻辑语句的数值嵌入，帮助神经网络更高效地排序逻辑推理器的候选答案。
嵌入训练使用三元组损失函数，需要锚点、正样本和负样本三个要素。
第一种方法：生成更可能包含重复项的锚点，以提升嵌入的区分能力。
第二种方法：构建正负样本时确保难易程度（简单、中等、困难）的合理分布。
第三种方法：训练过程中周期性加大对最困难样本的关注权重。
实验跨多个知识库对比不同嵌入方法，分析何种嵌入特征最适合特定推理任务。

articles.title: Embedding by Elicitation: Dynamic Representations for Bayesian Optimization of System Prompts
author: [[Zhiyuan Jerry Lin, Benjamin Letham, Samuel Dooley, Maximilian Balandat, Eytan Bakshy]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.19093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: System prompts are a central control mechanism in modern AI systems, shaping behavior across conversations, tasks, and user populations. Yet they are difficult to tune when feedback is available only as aggregate metrics rather than per-example labels, failures, or critiques. We study this aggregate feedback setting as sample-constrained black-box optimization over discrete, variable-length text. We introduce ReElicit, a Bayesian optimization framework based on \emph{embedding by elicitation}. Given a task description, previously evaluated prompts, and scalar scores, an LLM elicits a compact, interpretable feature space and maps prompts into it. Leveraging a probabilistic Gaussian process surrogate, an acquisition function then selects target feature vectors, which the LLM realizes and refines into deployable system prompts. Re-eliciting the feature space as new evaluations arrive lets the representation adapt to the observed prompt-score history. We evaluate the setting using offline benchmark accuracy as a controlled aggregate proxy: the optimizer observes one scalar score per prompt and no per-example labels, errors, or critiques. Across ten system prompt optimization tasks with a 30 total evaluation budget, ReElicit achieves the strongest aggregate performance profile among representative aggregate-only prompt-optimization baselines. These results suggest that LLMs can serve as adaptive semantic representation builders, not only prompt generators, for Bayesian optimization over natural-language artifacts.
articles.tldr: ReElicit 用 LLM 启发式嵌入做系统提示词贝叶斯优化，30 次评估内优于基线方法
articles.objective_summary: arXiv 论文提出 ReElicit 框架，通过 LLM 启发式嵌入将提示词映射到紧凑特征空间，结合高斯过程代理模型和采集函数进行贝叶斯优化。在 10 个提示词优化任务上、30 次总评估预算内取得最优聚合性能。
key_logic_flow: ReElicit 是一个贝叶斯优化框架，专门解决仅有聚合指标反馈（无逐样本标签）时的系统提示词调优问题。
框架通过

articles.title: Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance for Flow Models under Compositional Rewards
author: [[Xuehui Yu, Fucheng Cai, Meiyi Wang, Xiaopeng Fan, Harold Soh]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20758v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inference-time guided sampling steers state-of-the-art diffusion and flow models without fine-tuning by interpreting the generation process as a controllable trajectory. This provides a simple and flexible way to inject external constraints (e.g., cost functions or pre-trained verifiers) for controlled generation. However, existing methods often fail when composing multiple constraints simultaneously, which leads to deviations from the true data manifold. In this work, we identify root causes of this off-manifold drift and find that the approximation error scales severely with gradient misalignment. Building on these findings, we propose Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance ($g^\text{car}$), a lightweight and learnable method, which actively rectifies off-manifold drift by dynamically detecting and resolving gradient conflicts. We validate $g^\text{car}$ across diverse domains, ranging from synthetic datasets and image editing to generative decision-making for planning and control. Our results demonstrate that $g^\text{car}$ effectively rectifies off-manifold drift, surpassing baselines in generation fidelity while using light compute. Code is available at https://github.com/yuxuehui/CAR-guidance.
articles.tldr: 提出冲突感知加性引导方法，解决流模型在多约束组合生成中的离流形漂移问题。
articles.objective_summary: 该研究识别了扩散模型和流模型在推理时组合多个约束进行引导生成时产生离流形漂移的根本原因，发现近似误差随梯度方向不一致性严重放大。基于此提出冲突感知加性引导（g^car），一种轻量级可学习方法，通过动态检测和解决梯度冲突来主动修正漂移。在合成数据集、图像编辑和生成式决策规划等多个领域验证了有效性。
key_logic_flow: 现有推理时引导采样方法可无需微调即可控制扩散模型和流模型的生成过程，但在组合多个约束时效果不佳，会导致偏离真实数据流形的问题。
研究首先识别了组合约束下离流形漂移的根本原因，证明梯度方向不一致性会严重放大近似误差。
提出冲突感知加性引导（g^car），一种轻量级可学习方法，通过动态检测和解决梯度冲突来主动修正离流形漂移。
在合成数据集、图像编辑和生成式决策规划等多个领域验证了方法有效性，g^car在生成保真度上超越基线方法且计算开销低。

articles.title: Operationalizing Document AI: A Microservice Architecture for OCR and LLM Pipelines in Production
author: [[Yao Fehlis, Benjamin Bengfort, Zhangzhang Si, Vahid Eyorokon, Prema Roman, Patrick Deziel, Devon Slonaker, Steve Veldman, Ben Johnson, Joyce Rigelo, Michael Wharton, Steve Kramer]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.18818v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Academic research tends to focus on new models for document understanding creating a wide gap in the literature between model definition and running models at production scale. To close that gap, we present a microservice architecture that encapsulates pipelines of multiple models for classification, optical character recognition (OCR), and large language model structured field extraction as well as our experience running this pipeline on thousands of multi-page documents per hour. We describe our primary design decisions, including a hybrid classification, separation of GPU-bound inference from CPU-bound orchestration, use of asynchronous processing for the many IO-bound operations in the pipeline, and an independent, horizontal scaling strategy. Using batch profiling, we identified two surprising qualitative findings that shape production deployments: OCR, not language-model parsing, dominates end-to-end latency, and the system saturates at a concurrency determined by shared GPU-inference capacity rather than worker count. Our goal is to provide practitioners with concrete architectural patterns for building document understanding systems that work beyond the benchmark; effectively operationalizing models in production.
articles.tldr: 提出并验证了面向生产环境的文档AI微服务架构，发现OCR延迟是主要瓶颈而非LLM推理。
articles.objective_summary: 该论文提出了一种面向生产环境的文档AI微服务架构，将分类、OCR和LLM结构化字段提取封装为多模型流水线。通过批量性能分析发现：OCR是端到端延迟的主要瓶颈，而非LLM解析；系统并发饱和度由共享GPU推理容量决定，而非工作进程数量。
key_logic_flow: 现有文献在文档理解模型定义与生产级运行之间存在较大空白，该论文旨在弥合这一鸿沟。
提出了一种微服务架构，将分类、光学字符识别（OCR）和大语言模型（LLM）结构化字段提取封装为多模型流水线。
架构设计决策包括：混合分类策略、GPU绑定推理与CPU绑定编排分离、IO密集型操作的异步处理、以及独立水平扩展策略。
通过批量化性能分析发现两个反直觉结论：OCR是端到端延迟的主要瓶颈，而非LLM解析阶段。
系统并发饱和度由共享GPU推理容量决定，而非工作进程数量。
该系统已在生产环境中经受了每小时数千页多页文档的处理验证。

articles.title: POLAR-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Privacy-Utility Trade-offs in LLM Agents
author: [[Qiaoyuan Zheng, Yiqu Yang, Qi Gao, Imanol Schlag]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.19127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents increasingly have access to private user data and act on the user's behalf when interacting with third-party systems. The user defines what may and must not be shared, and the agent must robustly follow that intent even when third-party systems behave adversarially. We introduce POLAR-Bench (Policy-aware adversarial Benchmark), in which a trusted model with a privacy policy and a task converses with a third-party model that adversarially probes for both task-relevant and protected attributes. Across 10 domains and 7,852 samples, we score privacy and utility by deterministic set-membership and vary privacy policy dimension and attack strategy along two orthogonal axes, producing a 5 times 5 diagnostic surface per model. Our results reveal a sharp split: current frontier models withhold over 99% of protected attributes, while smaller open-weight models in the 1--30B range, the class users most commonly run as their own trusted agent on-device or via private inference, score notably worse, with the weakest leaking over half. POLAR-Bench thus localizes where each model's intent-following breaks down, providing a foothold for privacy alignment where it matters most.
articles.tldr: POLAR-Bench 基准测试发现前沿 LLM 能保护99%隐私，但小模型泄露过半
articles.objective_summary: arXiv 论文提出 POLAR-Bench 诊断基准，通过10个领域7852个样本让持有隐私策略的可信模型与对抗性第三方对话，评估 LLM 代理的隐私-效用权衡。结果显示前沿模型能隐藏99%以上受保护属性，而1-30B参数的小模型最差者泄露超过一半。
key_logic_flow: POLAR-Bench 是一个诊断基准，用于评估 LLM 代理在隐私保护与任务效用之间的权衡表现。
该基准设计为可信模型持有隐私策略并与对抗性第三方模型对话，后者会主动探测任务相关属性和受保护属性。
基准覆盖10个领域共7852个样本，通过隐私策略维度和攻击策略两个正交轴构建5×5诊断矩阵。
当前前沿模型能隐藏超过99%的受保护属性，隐私保护表现优异。
1-30B参数范围的开放权重小模型表现显著较差，最弱的模型泄露超过一半的受保护属性。
POLAR-Bench 能够定位每个模型的意图遵循能力在何处失效，为隐私对齐提供针对性改进方向。

articles.title: OSCToM: RL-Guided Adversarial Generation for High-Order Theory of Mind
author: [[Sharmin Sultana Srishty, Kazi Mahathir Rahman, Malaika Parizat Sakkhi, Samia Shahid Prianna, Shaikhul Islam Sinat]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20423v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on many language tasks, but their Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning is still uneven in complex social settings. Existing benchmarks, including ExploreToM, do not always test the recursive beliefs and information asymmetries that make these settings difficult. This paper presents OSCToM (Observer-Self Conflict Theory of Mind), an approach for modeling nested belief conflicts in LLM-based ToM tasks. The key case is one in which an observer's view of another agent conflicts with the observer's own belief state. Such cases go beyond simple perspective-taking and require recursive, multi-layered reasoning. OSCToM combines reinforcement learning (RL), an extended domain-specific language, and compositional surrogate models to generate observer-self conflicts. In our experiments, OSCToM-8B gives the best overall result among the systems tested. It improves on the reported ExploreToM results on FANToM and remains competitive on Hi-ToM and BigToM. On the information-asymmetric FANToM benchmark, OSCToM reaches 76% accuracy, compared with the 0.2% reported by ExploreToM. The data-synthesis procedure is also 6x more efficient, indicating that targeted training data can help smaller models handle advanced cognitive reasoning. The project code is available at https://github.com/sharminsrishty/osct.
articles.tldr: OSCToM用RL引导对抗生成，建模高阶心智理论中的嵌套信念冲突，在FANToM基准上达76%准确率。
articles.objective_summary: arXiv论文提出OSCToM方法，结合强化学习、领域特定语言和组合替代模型，用于提升大语言模型在高阶心智理论任务中的递归信念推理能力。OSCToM-8B在FANToM基准上达到76%准确率（基线仅0.2%），数据合成效率提升6倍。
key_logic_flow: OSCToM（Observer-Self Conflict Theory of Mind）是一种针对高阶心智理论推理中嵌套信念冲突的建模方法，核心场景是观察者对他人信念的判断与观察者自身信念状态发生冲突。
该方法结合强化学习（RL）、扩展领域特定语言和组合替代模型，自动生成带有观察者-自我冲突的训练数据。
在信息不对称的FANToM基准测试中，OSCToM达到76%准确率，而ExploreToM仅报告0.2%。
OSCToM-8B在测试系统中取得最佳综合表现，在FANToM上优于ExploreToM已有结果，在Hi-ToM和BigToM上也保持竞争力。
OSCToM的数据合成效率比现有方法高6倍，表明针对性训练数据能帮助小型模型处理高级认知推理。

articles.title: Hallucination as Exploit: Evidence-Carrying Multimodal Agents
author: [[Guijia Zhang, Hao Zheng, Harry Yang]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.19192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal agents use screenshots, documents, and webpages to choose tool calls. When a false visual claim triggers a click, email, extraction, or transfer, hallucination becomes an authorization failure rather than an answer-quality error. We formalize this failure mode as hallucination-to-action conversion: an unsupported perceptual claim supplies the precondition that makes a privileged action appear permitted. We propose evidence-carrying multimodal agents (ECA), which treat free-form model text as inadmissible evidence. ECA decomposes each tool call into action-critical predicates, obtains typed certificates from constrained DOM/OCR/AX verifiers, and lets a deterministic gate grant only the privileges those certificates support. The architecture does not hide perception error; it converts opaque model belief into named verifier, schema, and implementation residuals. Verifier red-teaming over 1,900 attacks exposes this residual directly: four targeted hardening steps reduce gate bypass from 15% to 1.3%. With content-derived certificates, ECA obtains 0% unsafe-action rate on a 200-task end-to-end pipeline (Wilson 95% upper bound 2.67%) and a 120-task browser proof-of-concept (upper bound 4.3%). A direct HACR audit on 500 stratified task keys shows that unsupported action-critical claims reach unsafe execution for naive agents (100.0%) and prompt-only defense (49.6%), but not for ECA. Oracle-certificate replay on 7,488 GPT-5.4 benchmark traces serves as a gate-correctness sanity check, and neural judge baselines remain bypassable under the same threat model. The resulting principle is simple: model language may propose actions, but external evidence must authorize them.
articles.tldr: 论文提出证据携带型多模态智能体（ECA），用确定性门控阻止AI幻觉导致未授权操作。
articles.objective_summary: 一篇arXiv论文形式化了多模态智能体中幻觉引发未授权操作的安全漏洞，并提出ECA架构：将工具调用的前提条件分解为关键谓词，通过DOM/OCR/AX验证器获取类型化证书，由确定性门控仅授权证书支持的权限。在1900次攻击测试中，四次加固将门控绕过率从15%降至1.
key_logic_flow: 论文将多模态智能体中的幻觉问题重新定义为授权失败而非答案质量错误：虚假视觉断言触发点击、邮件、提取或转账等特权操作。
形式化提出了hallucination-to-action conversion（HACR）这一失效模式，即无证据支持的感知断言为特权操作提供了看似允许的前提条件。
提出证据携带型多模态智能体（ECA）架构，将模型自由文本视为不可采纳证据，工具调用需通过约束性DOM/OCR/AX验证器获取类型化证书。
确定性门控机制仅授予证书支持的权限，将不透明的模型信念转化为可追溯的验证器残留（verifier residuals）。
通过1900次红队攻击进行验证器对抗测试，四次针对性加固将门控绕过率从15%降至1.3%。
200任务端到端管线中ECA获得0%不安全操作率（Wilson 95%置信上限2.67%），500任务分层HACR审计显示朴素智能体unsafe execution率为100%，纯提示防御为49.6%，ECA为0%。

articles.title: VBFDD-Agent for Electric Vehicle Battery Fault Detection and Diagnosis: Descriptive Text Modeling of Battery Digital Signals
author: [[Joey Chan, Zhen Chen, Ershun Pan]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20742v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the rapid proliferation of electric vehicles, the safety and reliability of lithium-ion batteries have become critical concerns. Effective anomaly detection is essential for ensuring safe battery operation. However, as battery systems and operating scenarios become increasingly complex, battery fault diagnosis and maintenance require stronger cross-domain adaptability and human-AI collaboration. Traditional fault detection and diagnosis methods are usually designed for specific scenarios and predefined workflows, making them less effective in complex real-world applications. To address the scarcity of open-source battery fault report corpora and the lack of unified maintenance knowledge representation, this study proposes a descriptive text modeling approach for battery signal reports. Monitoring signals, statistical features, anomaly records, and state assessment results are transformed into structured and readable natural language descriptions, forming a language corpus for battery health diagnosis and maintenance. Based on this corpus, we propose VBFDD-Agent, a vehicle battery fault detection and diagnosis agent for automotive-grade battery systems. VBFDD-Agent integrates descriptive battery-state texts, historical case retrieval, local maintenance manuals, and large language model reasoning to generate structured diagnostic results and maintenance recommendations. Experiments show that the proposed framework can accurately perform anomaly monitoring based on descriptive textual representations and provide flexible, efficient, and actionable maintenance suggestions. Expert evaluation further confirms the practical value of the generated recommendations. Overall, VBFDD-Agent extends traditional battery diagnosis from label prediction to interpretable and maintenance-oriented decision support.
articles.tldr: 研究提出VBFDD-Agent，将电池数字信号转为描述性文本，结合LLM推理实现故障检测与诊断。
articles.objective_summary: 该研究提出VBFDD-Agent框架，将电池监测信号、统计特征等转换为结构化自然语言描述，结合历史案例检索、维修手册和LLM推理，生成诊断结果与维护建议。实验表明该框架能准确进行异常监测，专家评估确认了生成建议的实用价值。
key_logic_flow: 电动汽车锂离子电池系统日益复杂，传统故障诊断方法在跨域适应性和人机协作方面存在局限。
研究提出描述性文本建模方法，将电池监测信号、统计特征、异常记录和状态评估结果转换为结构化自然语言描述，形成电池健康诊断语料库。
基于该语料库，研究提出VBFDD-Agent框架，整合电池状态文本、历史案例检索、本地维修手册和LLM推理能力。
VBFDD-Agent能生成结构化的诊断结果和可操作的维护建议。
实验证明该框架能基于描述性文本表示准确进行异常监测，并提供灵活高效的维护建议。
专家评估确认了生成建议的实用价值，该框架将传统电池诊断从标签预测扩展到可解释的、面向维护的决策支持。

articles.title: COAgents: Multi-Agent Framework to Learn and Navigate Routing Problems Search Space
author: [[Oleksandr Yakovenko, Mahdi Mostajabdaveh, Cheikh Ahmed, Abdullah Ali Sivas, Xiaorui Li, Zirui Zhou, Mao Kun]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although Vehicle Routing Problems (VRP) are essential to many real-world systems, they remain computationally intractable at scale due to their combinatorial complexity. Traditional heuristics rely on handcrafted rules for local improvements and occasional \textit{jumps} to escape local minima, but often struggle to generalize across diverse instances. We introduce \textbf{COAgents}, a cooperative multi-agent framework that models the search process as a graph: nodes represent solutions, and edges correspond to either local refinements or large perturbations for diversification (i.e., jumps). A \textit{Partial Search Graph} (PSG) is dynamically constructed during search, enabling COAgents to train a Node Selection Agent and a Move Selection Agent to guide intensification, and a Jump Agent to trigger well-timed explorations of new regions. Unlike end-to-end learning approaches, COAgents cleanly separates problem-agnostic search control from compact domain-specific encoding, facilitating adaptability across tasks. Extensive experiments on the CVRP and VRPTW benchmarks show that COAgents remains competitive with several learn-to-search baselines on CVRP and sets a new state of the art among learning-based methods on the more challenging VRPTW instances, reducing the gap to the best-known solutions by 14\% at $N\!=\!100$ and 44\% at $N\!=\!50$ relative to the strongest neural solver (POMO), and by 21\% and 40\% respectively relative to ALNS. Code is available at https://github.com/mahdims/COAgents.
articles.tldr: COAgents 多智能体框架通过部分搜索图动态引导路径规划，在 VRPTW 上创下学习方法新纪录
articles.objective_summary: arXiv 论文提出 COAgents 多智能体协同框架，将组合优化搜索过程建模为图结构，动态构建部分搜索图（PSG）并训练节点选择、移动选择和跳跃三个智能体协同搜索。在 CVRP 基准上与现有学习方法相当，在 VRPTW 基准上以学习方法达最优，N=100 时相比 POMO 将差距缩小 14%。
key_logic_flow: COAgents 将路径规划问题的搜索过程建模为图结构，其中节点代表解，边代表局部改进或大幅扰动（跳跃）。
框架在搜索过程中动态构建部分搜索图（PSG），用于训练节点选择智能体和移动选择智能体以引导强度搜索。
跳跃智能体（Jump Agent）负责在适当时机触发对新区域的探索，帮助搜索跳出局部最优。
COAgents 将问题无关的搜索控制逻辑与紧凑的领域特定编码分离，提升了跨不同任务的适应能力。
在 CVRP 基准上，COAgents 与多种学习式搜索基线方法保持竞争力。
在更具挑战性的 VRPTW 实例上，COAgents 在所有学习方法中取得最优结果，在 N=100 和 N=50 时分别将最优解的差距缩小 14% 和 44%（相对 POMO），以及 21% 和 40%（相对 ALNS）。

articles.title: Tool-Augmented Agent for Closed-loop Optimization,Simulation,and Modeling Orchestration
author: [[Liyuan Deng, Shujian Deng, Yongkang Chen, Yongkang Dai, Zhihang Zhong, Linyang Li, Xiao Sun, Yilei Shi, Huaxi Huang]]
articles.description: arXiv:2605.20190v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Iterative industrial design-simulation optimization is bottlenecked by the CAD-CAE semantic gap: translating simulation feedback into valid geometric edits under diverse, coupled constraints. To fill this gap, we propose COSMO-Agent (Closed-loop Optimization, Simulation, and Modeling Orchestration), a tool-augmented reinforcement learning (RL) framework that teaches LLMs to complete the closed-loop CAD-CAE process. Specifically, we cast CAD generation, CAE solving, result parsing, and geometry revision as an interactive RL environment, where an LLM learns to orchestrate external tools and revise parametric geometries until constraints are satisfied. To make this learning stable and industrially usable, we design a multi-constraint reward that jointly encourages feasibility, toolchain robustness, and structured output validity. In addition, we contribute an industry-aligned dataset that covers 25 component categories with executable CAD-CAE tasks to support realistic training and evaluation. Experiments show that COSMO-Agent training substantially improves small open-source LLMs for constraint-driven design, exceeding large open-source and strong closed-source models in feasibility, efficiency, and stability.
articles.tldr: 提出COSMO-Agent框架，用强化学习训练LLM闭环执行CAD-CAE设计与仿真优化。
articles.objective_summary: arXiv论文提出COSMO-Agent，一种工具增强的强化学习框架，将CAD生成、CAE求解、结果解析和几何修正构建为交互式RL环境，训练小规模开源LLM完成闭环工业设计优化，在可行性、效率与稳定性上超越大模型。
key_logic_flow: 工业设计-仿真迭代优化面临CAD-CAE语义鸿沟，即仿真反馈无法直接转化为有效的几何编辑。
COSMO-Agent将CAD生成、CAE求解、结果解析和几何修正四个环节构建为一个交互式强化学习环境。
LLM在该环境中学习编排外部工具并反复修正参数化几何，直至所有约束被满足。
设计了多约束奖励函数，同时鼓励可行性、工具链鲁棒性和结构化输出的有效性。
贡献了覆盖25个零部件类别的工业对齐数据集，支持真实的CAD-CAE任务训练与评估。
实验表明COSMO-Agent训练显著提升小规模开源LLM的约束驱动设计能力，在可行性、效率和稳定性上超越大型开源和强闭源模型。

articles.title: Builders
author: [[Ben Tossell]]
articles.description: GPT-5.5 is a good model
articles.tldr: Ben's Bites 报道 GPT-5.5 发布、Claude 质量下降及 Cursor 与 SpaceX 收购协议
articles.objective_summary: 2026年4月28日，Ben's Bites 新闻通讯报道了 OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.5、Anthropic 公开 Claude 质量下降原因、Cursor 与 SpaceX/XAI 达成潜在收购协议、Claude Managed Agents 记忆功能进入公测等 AI 行业动态，
key_logic_flow: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.5，声称性能优于 Opus 4.7，价格比 GPT-5.4 贵 2 倍，但 token 效率提高 40%，每任务成本变化不大。
Anthropic 发布故障分析报告，承认更改默认思考模式和系统提示词导致 Claude（尤其是 Claude Code）响应质量下降，但否认切换至量化或更差模型。
Claude Managed Agents 的记忆功能进入公开测试阶段，该产品让企业无需管理基础设施即可集成类似 Claude Code 的智能体。
Cursor 暂停以 500 亿美元估值融资 20 亿美元的计划，与 SpaceX/XAI 达成协议：SpaceX 有权在 2026 年底以 600 亿美元收购 Cursor，或支付 100 亿美元作为合作费用。
OpenAI 正在更新与 Microsoft 的合作伙伴关系，Sam Altman 和 Greg Brockman 首次共同接受采访。
作者 Ben 反思自身定位，表示希望服务于新型构建者群体——那些好奇、渐趋技术化并利用 AI 提升能力的人，强调提升下限而非上限。

articles.title: Can I get my agents on the phone?
articles.description: I haven’t used OpenClaw in weeks
articles.tldr: AI agent工具更新：Codex支持手机遥控，Anthropic收购Stainless，Cursor发布Composer 2.5
articles.objective_summary: Ben's Bites周报：Google I/O开幕（传闻Gemini接近GPT-5.5），Codex新增手机远程控制功能，Anthropic收购Stainless并更新Claude Managed Agents，Cursor发布Composer 2.
key_logic_flow: Google I/O开幕，传闻Gemini新模型在基准测试中接近GPT-5.5水平，但实际使用体验有待验证。
Codex新增手机连接功能，用户可从手机启动任务但计算仍在本地或远程机器上运行，可审批命令和查看差异。
Anthropic收购SDK平台Stainless并计划关闭该服务，同时为Claude Managed Agents新增自托管沙箱和MCP隧道功能。
Cloudflare测试Anthropic的Mythos模型，发现其擅长发现由多个小漏洞组合成的链式攻击，但单一模型缺乏好的编排仍会遗漏问题。
Cursor发布Composer 2.5（部分使用SpaceX的GPU训练），基准测试表现与Opus 4.7-xhigh和GPT-5.5-high相当但成本更低。
多家AI初创公司值得关注：Magicpath（设计画布）和Raindrop AI（生产环境agent监控）已支持外部编码agent调用。

articles.title: Google's take on openclaw
articles.description: it's Anthropic's time for the mandate of heaven
articles.tldr: Google I/O 发布 Gemini 多模态模型和 Gemini Spark 智能体；Andrej Karpathy 加入 Anthropic，
articles.objective_summary: Google I/O 发布 Gemini Omni Flash（视频生成）和 Gemini 3.5 Flash 模型及 Gemini Spark 24/7 个人智能体。Andrej Karpathy 加入 Anthropic 预训练团队。SpaceX IPO 文件披露 Anthropic 每月支付
key_logic_flow: Andrej Karpathy 加入 Anthropic 预训练团队，在 Nick Joseph 领导下组建新团队，利用 Claude 加速预训练研究。
SpaceX IPO 文件披露 Anthropic 每月将支付 12.5 亿美元用于算力。
Anthropic 预计 2025 年 6 月季度营收达 109 亿美元并首次实现运营利润。
Google I/O 发布 Gemini Omni Flash（首个支持视频生成的多模态模型）、Gemini 3.5 Flash 以及 24/7 个人智能体 Gemini Spark。
OpenAI 声称其模型解决了一个著名数学难题，且有外部数学家验证了该证明。
Cohere 发布开源企业模型 Command A+，支持文本/图像/工具调用，量化后可在单台 B200 上运行。

articles.title: Codex is gaining steam
author: [[Ben Tossell]]
articles.tldr: OpenAI 降低 Codex 使用门槛，支持非技术用户导入设置和插件
articles.objective_summary: OpenAI 于 2026 年 5 月发布 Codex 一系列更新：允许用户从 Claude Cowork 等工具导入设置、插件和项目配置，并针对日常办公场景（如创建幻灯片和表格）改进功能，同时优化 UI 界面以吸引非技术用户。
key_logic_flow: OpenAI 正在推动非技术用户转向使用 Codex，提供从 Claude Cowork 等工具导入设置、插件、代理和项目配置的功能。
Codex 针对日常工作场景进行了改进，包括创建幻灯片和表格等功能，并进行了 UI 界面的友好化改造。
xAI 发布了 Grok 4.3 模型 API，支持 100 万 token 上下文、文本和图像输入、推理功能，知识截止日期为 2025 年 12 月，定价为每百万输入 token 1.25 美元、输出 token 2.50 美元。
GitHub 前 CEO 创立的公司 Entire 发布了两个新工具：git-sync（无本地克隆的远程仓库镜像工具）和 Dispatches（基于仓库/日期范围生成发布说明的平台功能）。
Google 在 Gemini API 中新增了 Webhooks 功能，用于改进批处理、代理和 GenMedia 等长时间运行任务的开发者体验。

articles.title: ChatGPT's Nano Banana
author: [[Ben Tossell]]
articles.tldr: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.0 和 Workspace Agents；Google 推出 Gemini Deep Research
articles.objective_summary: 2026年4月22-23日期间，OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.0（改进图像生成能力）和面向企业/教育用户的 Workspace Agents；Google 发布基于 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 Deep Research API，支持 MCP 和 Nano
key_logic_flow: OpenAI 发布了 ChatGPT Images 2.0，在文字渲染和逼真图像生成方面大幅超越此前水平，支持在 Codex 中作为技能使用，并可结合思考模型获得最佳效果。
OpenAI 面向 Business、Enterprise 和 Edu 用户推出了 Workspace Agents，基于 Codex 驱动的智能体，支持设置人格角色、任务分配和外部工具访问（如 Linear），并可通过 Slack 使用，将逐步取代自定义 GPT。
Google 发布了基于 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 Deep Research API，声称在网络研究和事实查找方面性能最佳，新增 MCP 支持并可使用 Nano Banana 或 HTML 创建图表。
Cursor 与 SpaceX 达成合作，Cursor 可在 SpaceX GPU 上训练模型，SpaceX 有权选择以600亿美元收购 Cursor，或支付100亿美元合作费用。
Claude Code 推出 /ultrareview 功能（研究预览版），允许在合并高风险变更前在云端运行 bug 检测智能体。
OpenAI 开源了聊天数据和 Codex 会话日志查看器 Euphony；ChatGPT for Excel 和 Google Sheets 进入 beta 阶段。

articles.title: Building gets easier
author: [[Ben Tossell]]
articles.tldr: Ben's Bites 汇总 AI 工具更新：Cloudflare/Stripe 面向智能体开放服务、Warp 开源、Cursor SDK 发布。
articles.objective_summary: Ben Tossell 在 2026 年 4 月 30 日的新闻通讯中，分享其使用 Codex 进行日常任务和编码的个人体验。汇总 Cloudflare、Stripe、Warp、Cursor 等多家公司的 AI 产品更新，涉及智能体自主创建账户、支付、部署以及 AI 编码工具链演进。
key_logic_flow: Ben Tossell 分享自己从使用终端转向 Codex 应用的过程，建立了基于 AI 的日常任务管理和记忆系统。
Cloudflare 推出新功能，允许 AI 智能体自主创建账户、购买域名和部署应用，人类仅审批权限和条款。
Stripe 在 Sessions 大会上发布 Agentic Commerce Suite、Link 智能体钱包、流式支付和智能体版 Treasury 账户。
Warp 终端正式开源，OpenAI 作为创始赞助商；Cursor 发布 TypeScript SDK，允许开发者使用其运行时构建智能体。
Lightfield 推出 AI 原生 CRM 的 Skills 功能，支持自然语言定义工作流并自动执行；Amazon 发布 Quick 工具连接邮件、日历等自动化任务。
多家公司推出新模型与工具：OpenAI 解释模型幻觉问题、Poolside 发布编码模型、Ghostty 宣布离开 GitHub。

articles.title: How AI Mode is changing the way people search in the U.S.
author: [[Shivani Mohan]]
articles.description: A graphic features the text "How people are using AI Mode in the U.S." surrounded by colorful, stylized illustrations of a pencil, planet, banana, gift box, cursor, gamepad, and lipstick on a light blue background.
articles.tldr: Google AI Mode上线一周年，全球月活超10亿，用户搜索行为显著变化
articles.objective_summary: Google于一年前在美国推出AI Mode搜索功能，目前全球月活跃用户超过10亿，查询量每季度翻倍以上。数据显示，美国市场超1/6搜索使用语音或图片，搜索长度为传统搜索3倍，规划类查询增速比整体快80%。
key_logic_flow: Google在美国推出AI Mode搜索功能已满一周年，全球月活跃用户突破10亿。
AI Mode查询量自上线以来每季度翻倍以上，AI新功能推动搜索查询量创历史新高。
美国市场超过六分之一的搜索使用语音或图片方式，图片搜索月环比增长超过40%。
AI Mode的平均搜索长度达到传统搜索查询的3倍，用户倾向于提出更长的问题。
与规划相关的AI Mode查询在过去6个月中增速比整体查询快80%。
AI Mode中的头脑风暴类查询增速比整体查询快30%，以"where to"、"where should I"和"ideas for"开头的搜索正在增长。

articles.title: We’re announcing new community investments in Missouri.
articles.description: We’re helping build the state’s next-generation workforce and investing in energy programs.
articles.tldr: 谷歌在密苏里州新建数据中心，投入2000万美元能源基金并支持500兆瓦电力扩容。
articles.objective_summary: 谷歌宣布在密苏里州蒙哥马利县新建数据中心，与Ameren公司签署容量承诺框架协议支持超500兆瓦额外电力容量，设立2000万美元能源影响基金用于降低家庭电费，并资助当地建筑劳工培训项目。
key_logic_flow: 谷歌宣布在密苏里州蒙哥马利县新建一座数据中心，深化在当地的基础设施布局。
谷歌与Ameren电力公司通过容量承诺框架协议，支持开发超过500兆瓦的额外电力容量，并承诺覆盖自身运营和基础设施成本。
谷歌设立2000万美元的能源影响基金，用于通过房屋保温和能效改造项目帮助家庭降低电费账单。
谷歌的数据中心每创造一个直接就业岗位，可带动九个本地间接就业岗位。
谷歌资助建设劳工与承包商联合培训基金，为密苏里州蒙哥马利县培训数千名新建筑工人和学徒。

articles.title: 100 things we announced at I/O 2026
author: [[Keyword Team]]
articles.description: Image with the words "Ready, Set, I/O" and a colorful Gemini logo
articles.tldr: Google I/O 2026 发布 Gemini 3.5 Flash、Gemini 3.5 Pro 和 Gemini Omni 等新模型与工具。
articles.objective_summary: Google 在 I/O 2026 大会上正式发布 Gemini 3.5 Flash（即日可用），其在多项基准上超越 Gemini 3.1 Pro；预告 Gemini 3.5 Pro（下月推出）；并发布多模态视频生成模型 Gemini Omni，支持从任意输入生成输出。
key_logic_flow: Google 在 I/O 2026 上发布新一代模型 Gemini 3.5 Flash，即日通过 Google Antigravity、Gemini API、AI Studio 和 Android Studio 向开发者开放。
Gemini 3.5 Flash 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1（76.2%）、GDPval-AA（1656 Elo）和 MCP Atlas（83.6%）等基准测试上超越 Gemini 3.1 Pro，达到旗舰级智能水平。
Gemini 3.5 Flash 定位于长周期智能体任务，能以低于其他前沿模型一半的成本，在更短时间内完成应用开发、代码维护和金融文档准备等复杂工作。
Gemini 3.5 Pro 已在 Google 内部使用，预计 2026 年 6 月正式推出。
Google 发布新模型 Gemini Omni，可从任意输入生成任意输出，首发支持视频生成，融合物理理解能力（重力、动能、流体力学）并内置 SynthID 数字水印。

articles.title: Gemini 3.5: frontier intelligence with action
author: [[Noam Shazeer]]
articles.description: Gemini 3.5 text and multi-colored star icon on an abstract blue background.
articles.tldr: Google 发布 Gemini 3.5 Flash，前沿智能与行动能力的结合
articles.objective_summary: Google 于 2026年5月22日发布 Gemini 3.5 Flash 模型，这是 Gemini 3.5 系列的首个版本。该模型具备前沿的智能体与编程能力，在多个基准测试上超越上一代 Pro 模型，已通过 Gemini 应用、Antigravity 平台、AI Studio
key_logic_flow: Google 正式发布 Gemini 3.5 系列模型，首款推出 3.5 Flash，面向智能体和编码场景提供前沿性能。
3.5 Flash 通过 Gemini 应用、Google 搜索 AI Mode、Antigravity 平台、AI Studio 和 Android Studio 等多个渠道向全球用户开放。
3.5 Pro 正在内部使用中，计划于下个月正式发布。
3.5 Flash 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1（76.2%）、GDPval-AA（1656 Elo）、MCP Atlas（83.6%）和 CharXiv Reasoning（84.2%）等基准测试中超越上一代旗舰模型 Gemini 3.1 Pro，输出速度是其他前沿模型的 4 倍。
3.5 Flash 结合 Antigravity 框架可部署协作性子智能体，用于开发应用、维护代码库和准备财务文档等长周期实际任务，成本低于其他前沿模型的一半。
该模型在 Artificial Analysis 指数中位于右上象限，兼具前沿级智能和极快速度。

articles.title: A new experiment brings better group meetings to Google Beam
author: [[Mohamed Abdelgany]]
articles.description: A small group meeting featuring two in-room participants and three participants on-screen.
articles.tldr: Google Beam推新实验，用HP Dimension显示屏和空间音频改善远程会议沉浸感
articles.objective_summary: Google Beam与HP合作，利用HP Dimension沉浸式显示器将非Beam设备参会者以真人比例呈现，并配合空间音频技术将声音定位到说话者位置。该实验自动适配家庭和办公室场景，研究称可提升50%社交连接感和21%发言参与度。
key_logic_flow: Google Beam推出新实验，将沉浸式群组会议功能扩展至更多设备
该实验使用HP Dimension沉浸式显示器，将非Beam设备参会者以真实比例呈现，仿佛围坐在同一张桌子旁
配合空间音频技术，每位发言者的声音被锚定在其对应位置，实现听觉上的空间定位
该优化自动适用于家庭和办公室场景，无需手动配置
研究表明该方案可提升50%的社交连接感和21%的发言参与度，有助于缩小混合办公的'包容性差距'
Google Beam正在与Google Workspace和Zoom合作，持续提升现有会议体验

articles.title: I/O 2026
articles.description: At Google I/O 2026, we shared how we’re making AI more helpful for everyone. See everything we announced.
articles.tldr: Google I/O 2026 发布 Gemini Omni 和 Gemini 3.5 模型，推出 Antigravity 智能体开发平台
articles.objective_summary: Google 在 2026 年 I/O 大会上发布两款新模型 Gemini Omni 和 Gemini 3.5 Flash，推出 Antigravity 智能体优先开发平台，并在搜索、Gemini 应用、Universal Cart 等产品中集成智能体功能。
key_logic_flow: Google 在 I/O 2026 上发布 Gemini Omni 模型，可从任意输入（首发视频）创建内容，在多模态理解和编辑方面取得突破。
Google 发布 Gemini 3.5 Flash 模型，是结合前沿智能与行动能力的新模型系列首款产品。
Google 推出 Antigravity 智能体优先开发平台，从辅助写作工具转向辅助行动的智能体。
Google 在搜索中引入信息智能体，在 Gemini 应用中推出 Gemini Spark 和 Daily Brief 功能。
Google 推出 Universal Cart 通用智能购物车，实现真正智能的购物体验。
Google 将 Gemini 扩展到 Google Pics、智能眼镜和 Ask YouTube 等更多产品和形态。

articles.title: New ways to create and get things done in Google Workspace
author: [[Yulie Kwon Kim]]
articles.description: Google Workspace
articles.tldr: Google 为 Workspace 推出语音交互、AI 收件箱、Gemini Spark 智能体和 Google Pics 图片应用
articles.objective_summary: Google 于 2026 年 5 月宣布在 Google Workspace 中推出多项 AI 新功能，包括 Gmail Live、Docs Live 和 Keep 的语音交互能力，Google Pics 图片生成与编辑应用，AI Inbox 扩展至更多订阅用户，以及全新的 24/7 个人 AI
key_logic_flow: Google 宣布在 Gmail、Docs 和 Keep 中推出新的语音交互功能，用户可通过语音搜索邮件（Gmail Live）、口述起草文档（Docs Live）和快速整理笔记（Keep）。
Google 推出全新应用 Google Pics，用于 AI 图像生成与编辑，面向从专业到日常的创意项目。
AI Inbox 功能扩展至 Google AI Plus 和 Pro 订阅用户，帮助用户更好地管理收件箱。
Google 推出 Gemini Spark，一个 24/7 全天候个人 AI 智能体，可在 Gemini 应用中帮助用户处理数字生活事务并与 Workspace 应用集成。
上述新功能将于今年夏季向 Google AI Pro、Ultra 订阅用户以及 Google Workspace 商业客户开放预览。

articles.title: A new era for AI Search
author: [[Elizabeth Reid]]
articles.description: Text that reads "The best of a search engine with the best of AI"
articles.tldr: Google I/O 2026宣布搜索全面AI化：AI Mode月活超10亿，升级Gemini 3.5 Flash，推出智能搜索框和信息代理
articles.objective_summary: Google在2026年I/O大会上宣布搜索产品多项AI升级：AI Mode月活用户突破10亿，查询量每季度翻倍；将Gemini 3.5 Flash设为AI Mode默认模型；重新设计搜索框支持多模态输入；推出可在后台7x24小时运行的信息代理功能。
key_logic_flow: Google AI Mode上线一年后月活跃用户突破10亿，查询量每季度翻倍，整体搜索查询量达到历史最高。
Google将Gemini 3.5 Flash设为AI Mode的默认模型，向全球所有用户开放。
Google推出25年来搜索框最大升级：智能搜索框支持文本、图片、文件、视频和Chrome标签页多模态输入，并提供AI驱动的搜索建议。
用户可在AI Overview中直接追问，与AI Mode形成连续对话，上下文保持连贯，链接推荐随探索深入而更精准。
Google推出搜索代理功能：用户可在搜索中创建、定制和管理多个AI信息代理，这些代理在后台7x24小时运行，跨博客、新闻、社交及实时数据监控信息变化。

articles.title: Everything new in our Google AI subscriptions, fresh from I/O 2026
author: [[Shimrit Ben-Yair]]
articles.description: The image shows colorful icons. The copy reads: More magic in one plan. More power, more perks, same price.
articles.tldr: Google I/O 2026 发布新 AI 订阅套餐：$100/月的 AI Ultra 开发者计划，并将最高套餐从 $250 降至 $200。
articles.objective_summary: Google 在 I/O 2026 上宣布推出每月 100 美元的 AI Ultra 订阅计划，面向开发者和技术人员，包含 Gemini 3.5 Flash、Antigravity 平台优先访问、20TB 存储和 YouTube Premium。
key_logic_flow: Google 在 I/O 2026 上宣布推出每月 100 美元的全新 AI Ultra 计划，面向开发者、技术负责人和高级创作者。
