articles.tldr: agentmemory 为 AI 编程代理提供持久化记忆，支持跨会话自动捕获和检索上下文。
articles.objective_summary: rohitg00 发布 agentmemory v0.9.x，一个基于 iii-engine 的持久化记忆工具，通过 MCP 协议为 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等编程代理提供自动记忆捕获、混合搜索（BM25+向量+图）和 12 个生命周期钩子，在
key_logic_flow: agentmemory 是一个基于 iii-engine 的持久化记忆工具，为 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Codex CLI 等编程代理提供跨会话记忆功能，避免重复解释上下文。
该工具通过 12 个生命周期钩子（SessionStart、UserPromptSubmit、PreToolUse 等）自动捕获代理行为，无需手动调用 add()。
检索使用 BM25 + 向量 + 知识图谱的混合搜索（RRF 融合），嵌入模型为本地免费的 all-MiniLM-L6-v2，存储使用 SQLite，无外部依赖。
在 LongMemEval 基准测试中达到 95.2% 的检索 R@5，每次会话约消耗 1,900 tokens（约每年 10 美元）。
提供实时查看器（端口 3113）、会话回放功能，并支持从 Claude Code JSONL 文件导入历史会话。
与竞品 mem0、Letta、Khoj 相比，agentmemory 强调零框架锁定、多代理协同、自托管和低 token 消耗。

articles.title: Imbad0202/academic-research-skills
articles.description: Academic Research Skills for Claude Code: research → write → review → revise → finalizeAcademic Research Skills for Claude Code 简体中文版 | 繁體中文版 | 日本語版 A comprehensive suite of Claude Code skills for academic research, covering the full pipeline from research to publication. Install in 30 seconds (Claude Code CLI / VS Code / JetBrains, v3.7.0+): /plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills /plugin install academic-research-skills Then try /ars-plan to walk through your paper structure via Socratic dialogue, or jump to Quick install for prerequisites and the traditional symlink flow. AI is your copilot, not the pilot. This tool won't write your paper for you. It handles the grunt work — hunting down references, formatting citations, verifying data, checking logical consistency — so you can focus on the parts that actually require your brain: defining the question, choosing the method, interpreting what the data means, and writing the sentence after "I argue that." Unlike a humanizer, this tool doesn't help you hide the fact that you used AI. It helps you write better. Style Calibration learns your voice from past work. Writing Quality Check catches the patterns that make prose feel machine-generated. The goal is quality, not cheating. Why human-in-the-loop, not full automation? Lu et al. (2026, Nature 651:914-919) built The AI Scientist — the first fully autonomous AI research system to publish a paper through blind peer review at a top-tier ML venue (ICLR 2025 workshop, score 6.33/10 vs workshop average 4.87). Their Limitations section enumerates the failure modes that any fully-autonomous AI research pipeline inherits: implementation bugs, hallucinated results, shortcut reliance, bug-as-insight reframing, methodology fabrication, frame-lock, citation hallucinations. ARS is built on the premise that a human researcher augmented by AI avoids these failure modes better than either alone. Stage 2.5 and Stage 4.5 integrity gates run a 7-mode blocking checklist (see academic-pipeline/references/ai_research_failure_modes.md); the reviewer offers an opt-in calibration mode that measures its own FNR/FPR against a user-supplied gold set. Zhao et al. (2026-05) audited 111M references across 2.5M papers on arXiv, bioRxiv, SSRN, and PMC. Their conservative estimate is 146,932 hallucinated citations for 2025 alone, with an observed mid-2024 inflection; for the bioRxiv-to-PMC pairing they report 85.3% preprint-to-published persistence. The paper describes "real citations deployed to support claims the cited references do not actually make" as an open challenge. Stage-by-stage matrix with agents, artifacts, and gates: see ARCHITECTURE.md §3. v3.0 Optimizations: What We Discovered About AI's Structural Limits What happened While using ARS to write a reflection article about AI in higher education, I ran into three structural problems that no amount of prompt engineering could fix: Frame-lock: I asked the AI to run a devil's advocate debate against its own thesis. It did — four rounds, each more refined than the last. But every round stayed inside the frame I'd set. The DA attacked arguments, never premises. It never asked "are we even discussing the right question?" This is the same pattern that caused the 31% citation error rate in v2.7's stress test: the verifying AI and the generating AI share the same cognitive frame. Sycophancy under pushback: Every time I challenged the DA's attacks, it conceded too quickly. It retracted findings faster than it launched them. The model's training rewards conversational harmony — so "the user pushed back" was treated as evidence that the attack was wrong, when often it just meant the user was persistent. Intent misdetection: The Socratic Mentor kept trying to converge and produce deliverables ("Want me to write this up?") when I was still exploring. It couldn't distinguish "the user wants a deep philosophical discussion" from "the user wants an RQ brief." Both look like engagement, but they need opposite AI behaviors. What we changed (v3.0) Devil's Advocate — Concession Threshold Protocol (deep-research + academic-paper-reviewer) DA must now score every rebuttal on a 1-5 scale before responding Concession only allowed at score ≥4 (rebuttal directly addresses core attack with evidence) Score ≤3: hold position and restate the original attack Anti-sycophancy rules: no consecutive concessions, concession rate tracking, frame-lock detection after each checkpoint Socratic Mentor — Intent Detection Layer (deep-research) Classifies user intent as exploratory vs. goal-oriented at dialogue start and every 3 turns Exploratory mode: disables auto-convergence, raises max rounds to 60, prohibits "want me to summarize?" prompts Goal-oriented mode: standard convergence behavior Anti-premature-closure rules: in exploratory mode, the user decides when to stop Socratic Mentor — Dialogue Health Indicator (deep-research) Silent self-assessment every 5 turns on three dimensions: persistent agreement, conflict avoidance, premature convergence Auto-injects challenging questions when agreement pattern detected Invisible to user (to prevent gaming), but log available for post-session review Why this matters These optimizations don't solve AI's structural limits — they make the limits visible and manageable. The DA will still eventually concede if pushed hard enough. The Socratic Mentor will still have some convergence bias. But now there are explicit checkpoints that slow down the sycophancy, force the DA to justify concessions, and prevent the Mentor from wrapping up before the user is ready. The deeper lesson: AI literacy isn't about learning to use AI as a tool, following ethics rules, or fearing AI risks. It's about engaging AI deeply enough to discover its structural limits yourself — and your own thinking limits in the process. License This work is licensed under CC-BY-NC 4.0. articles.objective_summary: Imbad0202 在 GitHub 上发布 academic-research-skills 工具集，这是一套面向学术研究的 Claude Code 技能，包含 Deep Research、Academic Paper、Academic Paper Reviewer、Academic
key_logic_flow: ARS 是一套面向学术研究的 Claude Code 技能集，覆盖从研究到发表的全流程，包含 Deep Research、Academic Paper、Academic Paper Reviewer、Academic Pipeline 四个核心模块。
ARS 的设计理念为“AI 是副驾驶而非驾驶员”，通过 Stage 2.5 和 Stage 4.5 的完整性检查机制，避免完全自主 AI 研究常见的实现错误、幻觉结果、方法捏造等失败模式。
v3.7+ 版本支持通过插件市场一键安装（/plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills），兼容 Claude Code CLI、VS Code 和 JetBrains 环境。
v3.8 版本新增可选声明审计功能（ARS_CLAIM_AUDIT=1），可抓取引用来源并判断声明是否被实际支持，新增五种高级警告类别，校准通过 FNR<0.15+FPR<0.10 的验收阈值。
ARS 可与实验代理（experiment-agent）配合使用，在 Stage 1 研究完成后运行实验，再将验证后的结果带入 Stage 2 写作环节。
该工具提供 APA 7.0、Chicago、MLA、IEEE、Vancouver 等多种引用格式支持，并包含 Style Calibration 和 Writing Quality Check 等写作质量功能。

articles.title: zakirullin/files.md
articles.description: 🌱 Private, quiet space for thinking. A simple app for your .md files. Files.md Private, quiet space for thinking. A simple app for your .md files. You can store your whole life: 📌 Notes 📝 Documents, Projects 💚 Journal, Habits ✅ Checklists, Tasks All in plain .md files, local-first. LLM-friendly. Private - no data is sent to server. Own your data as plain local files. Own the software that opens those files. Grow your knowledge with files and your own brain. Grow the software around it with an LLM. Plain files and self-owned software can last through the ages. Try it out: app.files.md (Beta). Main site: files.md. I have been building this project for 5 years. Consider supporting on GitHub 💚. Dump your thoughts · How to think deeply · Second Brain? · Journal, tasks and checklists Another note taking app? Maybe. But this time: Only necessary features, restrictions foster creativity No need to install anything, all you need is a browser Works offline Local-first, files don't leave your device Free and open source Extremely simple code. One person or an LLM can fit the whole project in head The codebase is ready for your LLM to extend to your needs Portable, no build systems, just open web/index.html Optional out of the box synchronization The server is just one binary (or use iCloud/Dropbox/Google Drive for sync) Telegram chatbot for on-the-go access to your files How to use Open app.files.md (Chrome is recommended) Click "Install files.md" on the right side of the address bar: Open a local folder to persist changes Occasionally hit force-refresh (Cmd+Shift+R) to get new updates. How to sync Setup Where your files live Sync across devices Server needed Best for Local-first, app.files.md doesn't send any data A folder on your device No None Maximum privacy, your data doesn't leave your device Cloud-folder sync (iCloud/Dropbox/Google Drive) Your existing cloud folder Yes None (cloud provider) Sync across devices without running a server Self-hosted sync server Your own (or local) server Yes One Go binary Sync between devices inside your network Hosted sync server Our managed server Yes api.files.md Try it instantly, no setup Dump your thoughts You can use chat to quickly dump your thoughts. Open the chat and send a message: Choose where to save (can do later): With this flow you can quickly save notes, tasks, journal records and checklists. Save things in the chatbot Open the chat, write something and press Enter: That's it. Telegram Bot. Other messengers will follow. How to think deeply Connect ideas. Let them compound. Think through. I used app.files.md to grow my knowledge about brain and software development I added new notes to either brain or dev folders. One idea per note I made connections between the relevant notes in the web app (type [) Everything is connected, just as in our brain I spent time travelling through the notes and thinking it through At one point, some brain and dev notes appeared very related This connection between two different domains produced an insight I wrote an article based on that insight: Cognitive Load in Software Development All this activity helped me to: Think deeply (which is very important in the AI-age) Think systematically and see the bigger picture Write insightful texts To achieve all that, you'll have to use your brain, not advanced templates or AI workflows. Start with no structure at all, 0 folders One idea per note Every note should be understood without context Apply new knowledge immediately, don't save it for future self Link related notes Revisit your notes and think through My friends and I have been using this simple setup for five years, and it works well. Second Brain? I'll quote I Deleted My Second Brain: Obsidian is a brilliant piece of software. I love it, dearly. But like anything, without restraint, it can also be a trap. Markdown files in nested folders. Plugins that track your productivity. Graph views that suggest omniscience. There’s an illusion of mastery in watching your notes web into constellations. But constellations are projections. They tell stories. They do not guarantee understanding. When I first started using PKM tools, I believed I was solving a problem of forgetting. Later, I believed I was solving a problem of integration. Eventually, I realized I had created a new problem: deferral. The more my system grew, the more I deferred the work of thought to some future self who would sort, tag, distill, and extract the gold. That self never arrived. The Second Brain is thrilling. Advanced guru templates, plugins and AI workflows... One wants to scrape the wisdom of the whole internet. There's some beauty in this neat system. Every new note brings dopamine. Second Brain gets better and better. However, the first brain never actually gets smarter. And that's an issue - in the AI age, your first brain is as valuable as ever. Use your brain to think through the notes. The tool is not important, your thinking is. Before adding a new note, try to answer these questions: How this new knowledge can sharpen my judgment or expand my taxonomy? How can I see the world differently, given this new knowledge? Notes can prevent experience Reading and taking notes can easily fool us into believing that we understand a text We think we understand, but in reality we just know At some point our "knowing" is so good, that we start feeling that we actually do it (or at least tried) The worst thing is that we don’t let new experiences emerge because we already have knowledge. It's a knowledge barrier. Life gives us opportunities to live through new experiences, but we refuse, because "we already know". Self-help through reading and taking notes? 🧘‍ Harm caused at the emotional level must be healed at the emotional level. Not through intellectual work and taking notes. Reading without action is entertainment. A form of procrastination. No amount of self-help books can heal emotional wounds. What can help is psychotherapy, rescripting and chair work. Meditation. Healing happens by feeling. When to take notes If your goal is to: Develop a deeper, more structured understanding of something Do research Write an article or a book Then taking notes is perfectly fine. Journal Are you feeling good about something? Send a message. Then click "To Journal". Or just add jj or жж at the end of your message. Your record is gonna be saved nicely in the journal/YYYY.MM Month.md file. Tasks ✅ You're in the flow. A colleague asks you to send a report. Holding that in your head drains energy. Drop a message and stay in flow. Add only small, actionable items. Not things like "Plan a vacation". Add the first tiny step of what should be done anyway. Not what you wish to be done, but don't have motivation just yet. Your task list should not create a feeling of guilt. For tasks that should be done later press "To Later". Checklists 🛒 A friend recommends a book to you. You're out of butter and buns. Holding things like this in your head is taxing. Drop all that to chat, then move to a matching checklist. Files structure You don't have to think about the structure, it is predefined. Although, you're free to use whatever structure you want. Chat: Chat.md Notes: brain/Note.md, <category>/*.md Checklists: Read.md, Watch.md, Shop.md, MyChecklist_.md Journal: journal/2024.08 August.md Tasks: Later.md Habits: habits/Ate consciously.md, habits/*.md Images: media/* (png, jpg, webp, gif) Archive: archive/*.md Config: config.json Scheme is also available at files.md/llms.txt. You can copy-paste it into CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, so that your AI agent would understand the structure. Hotkeys Hotkey Action [ Insert a link to a file Cmd+K / Ctrl+K Open file search modal Cmd+N / Ctrl+N New file Cmd+M / Ctrl+M Move file Cmd+D / Ctrl+D Delete file Cmd+Enter / Ctrl+Enter Open chat Cmd+Shift+Enter / Ctrl+Shift+Enter Toggle chat dialog Cmd+[ / Ctrl+[ Go to previous file Cmd+] / Ctrl+] Go to next file Cmd+~ / Ctrl+~ Toggle sidebar Cmd+B / Ctrl+B Toggle bold Cmd+I / Ctrl+I Toggle italic Cmd+Y / Ctrl+Y Insert checkbox Cmd/Ctrl + Click Copy inline text / open link Ctrl+Cmd+Space Insert emoji (macOS) Useful scripts for your files All scripts are in cmd and can be run inside your files directory. Install Go first. Add Whoop metrics to journal go run /abs/path/to/files.md/cmd/whoop/whoop.go Convert wikilinks to markdown links Convert [[wikilinks]] to standard [Name](/path.md) (--dry-run available): go run /abs/path/to/files.md/cmd/tomdlinks/tomdlinks.go . Insert backlinks Adds links back to referencing files (--dry-run available): go run /abs/path/to/files.md/cmd/backlink/backlink.go Shift journal timestamps Shift timestamps in journal files by N hours (useful after timezone change): go run /abs/path/to/files.md/cmd/shifttime/shifttime.go Documentation Deploy on your own server Chatbot Sync flow Integration tests Repository structure web - web app (PWA), index.html is an entrypoint web/lib - frontend libs cmd/server - entrypoint for server cmd/*/ - useful scripts for .md files server/bot.go - bot server/sync/ - sync API server code vendor - backend libs tests - E2E tests, test both the web app and the server How to contribute Junior developers should be able to understand the code Ideally, every PR should remove or simplify code, not add it The less code we have, the more flexible we are All dependencies are our code and responsibility. So, avoid dependencies if possible Code should be self-sufficient, so vendor and web/lib folders are included in the repository Do we really need this feature? Will it help us to do the real job, or does it just give dopamine? Refer to this guide for more comprehensive rules. Backend guidelines We write tests We don't use get* prefix for methods No panics, errors are part of business logic If we are ignoring an error - we leave a WHY comment We wrap errors all the time, we should add method's context No iterators for client code We prefer real implementations or at least fakes over mocks and stubs Imports should only be renamed to avoid a name collision with other imports With portability in mind, everything is stored in plain .md files Frontend guidelines Use PATCHED keyword if you modify libs in-place It would be fantastic if, one day, we replaced CodeMirror with our own tiny implementation No build systems, in 10 years we will open /web/index.html and it should just work Don't forget that awaits between lock check and lock acquire can cause race condition Avoid flaky e2e tests. First we get negative emotions, then we stop running all the tests Most bugs are caused due to race conditions, when an async flow is interrupted mid through Glossary filename - a filename with extension, like "note.md" (USE THIS AS ID) header - an extension-stripped and capitalized filename, like "Note" body - file's content dir - a dir that is meant to store notes under some category, like "happiness" userID - chatID. For the most part we're only using chatID as userID (PM with the bot) ctime for file - data blocks or metadata change time: file's ownership, location, file type and permission settings changed time. Parent folder renaming won't affect, moving the file does affect, renaming the file does affect. We need this to track file's location changes, like to understand when it was moved to archive, to track task's angry level etc mtime for file - mtime (modification time) for a file refers to the time when the contents of the file were last modified. Unlike ctime, it is not affected by changes to the file's metadata, such as ownership, permissions, or renaming. We rely on that for synchronization. ctime for dir - adding or removing files or subdirectories (similar to mtime plus inode changes like renaming files) Any file can be uniquely identified by filename and dir. We only support one level of nesting. Performance The project is blazing fast 😃 If you're afraid of using files or mutexes unnecessarily for performance reasons, take a look at this: Mutex lock/unlock = 25 ns Read 4K randomly from SSD = 150,000 ns 1 ms = 1,000,000 ns ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) 20.05.2026 Added LaTeX support, even though I wasn't happy about +20 font files. LaTeX is text-based and LLM-friendly. Text + Math will cover pretty much everything. 06.05.2026 Moved from Today.md to Chat.md. CustDev showed that users have trouble grasping "chat" concept. And besides, "open chat" phrase has meaning in both bot and webapp. 02.05.2026 Now hide-token runs synchronously on every change, previously it had 100ms debounce which caused jitter on by word removals in links and formatted texts. 06.05.2026 Merged Inbox.md and Today.md to Today.md. Inbox name is too abstract, productivity-related and GTD-ish. I want calmness and simplicity. Today is like "the page I live in chat". 23.04.2026 Moved from API_HOST, APP_HOST to API_URL, APP_URL. For different environments it's better to provide more information like desired schema in configuration. 22.04.2026 Inbox entries in the bot are now identified by a stable content hash (fs.Hash of the block with the - [ ] /- [x] marker stripped) instead of a positional index, so a button keeps pointing at the right line even if other entries are added/removed/completed in between. 06.05.2026 It was mentally taxing to see two buttons/messages "to inbox" and "to chat", it was not as mentally easy just to drop a task for chat. Because it went to inbox, and 1 more click needed. That one click was the reason adding new tasks became frustrating. I let go of two different flow, and now everything goes to inbox, and every item is inbox is a markdown checklist item. As a bonus, PWA app is now very handy as it shows tasks for chat by default. Also, maybe "inbox" is a mentally overloaded term, and "chat" sounds better. Will see. 11.04.2026 Even though I want to store links as plain markdown links, visually I want to work with them as if they were minimal [links]. For that I decided to hide (...) part when cursor is on the line. The (...) part is only hidden for markdown-files link. 11.04.2026 Brought back standard Markdown Links. I want the knowledge base to be cross-platform. It should work in GitHub. 05.04.2026 Tried to move web/* stuff in the root folder for simplicity. Bad decision - there should be an explicit dir which we can use as public DOCROOT on our server. 19.04.2026 Switched to [link] for links. The [link](full%20path) syntax is too overwhelming and clunky, plus we don't want to deal with path changes. 21.09.2025 Removed WASM. I had a bug when a message was removed from Inbox.txt, and was not added to a file (I pressed "move to file" button). I wasn't able to reproduce the issue, but what I found is a lot of complexity. JS -> Go (writeFile) -> Go awaiting a promise from JS -> JS Golang runtime somewhere in between -> JS (writeFile) -> Go (returning from promise) -> Sending results back to JS. And it has to be done in a separate goroutine, because both WASM and JS are running in the same thread. Also, Golang's WASM is still experimental. We have too many components and a lot of uncertainty involved. I didn't want to implement same functionality in JS back then, at the solution served for some time. Now it's time to reimplement the functionality in JS and give up all this complexity. Also, inbox.wasm is ~8MB and I wanted the application to be really small. 11.07.2025 Decided to use OPFS as an initial driver for file system. Better browsers support, less hustle for users. The app starts with OPFS driver by default, if needed, user can replace the driver with Local FileSystem API by opening a local dir. DirHandle would be saved to IndexedDB in such scenario and reused every time. 08.07.2025 Root folder is now '/', not ''. All files in webapp are identified by path, not by 'dir' + 'filename', restricting to 1 level of nesting. 11.04.2026 Dropbox is changing some metadata for newfly created files, thus ctime is changed. I was thinking about moving to mtime for sync, but that wouldn't allow us detect renames (though, we detect them through a separate mechanism anyway), so mtime can be more reliable. Also sync won't be triggered by permission/ownership change etc. Migrated to mtime. Mtime is used for content-based sync, ctime is used for append-only sync log (renames/del). Also we can restore mtime from .git/archive, unlike ctime. 30.06.2025 Decided to migrate every flow to Chat.md, even todo lists. Added - we can't work with multiline tasks with this flow, we may want support both files and indices. We have two ways of doing so - encode params in a uniform way, and use same command handlers with IFs. Or we can use different command handlers to handle chat/file movements. I decided to go for different command handlers. Added, if we go for different commands - move to buttons config would be complicated. Added, maybe we can move files back to Chat.md on "file move", and reuse the existing flow? Added, so far seems good. Our chat.md log acts as an append-only log. As a bonus, if we don't finish some flow (like schedule/move), the content would be saved in log and we can continue scheduling/moving from the app. 06.05.2026 All incoming messages go to Chat.md now by default. Before that they got moved to /chat (and become tasks), which was good for a simple todo list, but not as convenient for other use cases. I realized that during meetings, all I needed was a simple input field where I can dump whatever stuff from my head with no further immediate action. With a possibility to review and organize it later. It can be tasks, it can be journal records, or it can be files. Also, it's better to have a really simple easy to understand default flow - we dump all the messages into one file, and that's it. 27.06.2025 Default mode for chat is "One big file" now, i.e. the only thing it does is dumps all the messages into one file. Again, let's start with the simplest flow, not to overwhelm users. Added later. If we choose full mode, we'll have to create dirs upfront so that "to habits", "to read/shop" etc. would work. If users don't need it, he removes the dirs, and we don't recreate them (as we would do in "on-the-fly mode"). So, we can't use on-the-fly strategy everywhere. 26.06.2025 Before we created all necessary dirs upfront, now we create dirs on the fly. That way we won't clutter user's knowledge base right from the start. 24.06.2025 Switched to microseconds for tracking file changes during sync. Gap between consecutive files creation is more than enough - ranging from 5000μs to 1000μs. We didn't go for nanosec because js is having troubles with int64 precision. Added later. Linux is using cached kernel time, which is updated at CONFIG_HZ interval (grep CONFIG_HZ /boot/config-$(uname -r)), in my case the value is 1000 (1ms). Most real-world operations operations are spaced much further apart than 1ms due to: user interaction, network latency, disk i/o. We might only have issue if we update files inside an effective/native loop. 16.06.2025 I believe it's time to make our knowledge base cross-platform, by forbidding characters like ":?<>*" in filenames. These characters aren't allowed in some environments (like Windows, PWA). 15.09.2025 I wanted bot-like functionality in browser. I didn't want to re-write well-tested code in TypeScript, so I used wasm~~. And it worked perfectly good. 12.06.2025 We use Telegram bot as distract-free write-only entrance to our knowledge base. The only issue is, it is not as wildly popular in EU/USA. I've come to the idea that we can transform app.files.md to a chat once we decrease the window size! Would be default behaviour on mobiles. 04.06.2025 Introduced append-only log for syncing. Stateless sync is tricky to implement - we would have to send all files in every request. Since we're only renaming on server - we'll only track renames. 04.06.2025 For content-only sync (no renames/deletes) we don't store any state on server, we compare hashes & last ctimes 11.11.2024 Removed Wikilinks support. Only plain Markdown links, our knowledge base must be interoperable. 26.10.2024 Updates are now processed sequentially on per-user basis. Because there were some race conditions on concurrent file writings. Also we faced out-of-order forwarded messages processing, and it was impossible to collapse them to one message. 06.10.2024 Removed fyne.io. At first, I wanted a lightweight alternative to Electron, and fyne.io seemed to be an ideal candidate. After a few days working with it 80% of bot functionality was implemented, and I was pretty happy with it. The thing is, to implement the rest of the functionality, we would have to apply A TREMENDOUS amount of effort. I am talking tiny details such as scrolling, emojis rendering, text selecting behaviour, links support, etc. And in future we would have to implement image uploading and markdown/html renderer, which would be also painful in such non-webview based toolkit. As much as I hate using the web stack for the desktop applications, it doesn't seem like we have a choice. Let's try wails.io. 09.09.2024 We use vendoring for dependencies. We want all our few dependencies to be in the repo, so we don't care about blocked/removed dependencies. Our repository is the self-sufficient source of truth. 09.06.2025 We use granular locks (in db, journal, userconfig) instead of one global per user lock so to avoid bottlenecks. Workers might use 3rd party API like ChatGPT, and we don't want to hold user's lock all that time. PATCHED, we added sequential per-user updates processing, bot can't cause RCs on its own, but bot & worker can, so we should continue using granular locks. 20.08.2024 We read every userconfig value from the config file on every access. We don't need load/save whole config before/after bot.Answer() method. We have to reread it every time we need to change it, so we don't write back any stale data. Let's imagine we load config only once before bot.Answer(), next, we may have significant networking delays in bot.Answer() (let's say 2 seconds when making external requests), there are good changes that during those 2 seconds worker.MoveDueTasks() will modify userconfig.Schedule, causing data race (after bot's answer we write back stale data). And we don't want our schedule lost. 08.08.2024 Sanitize Early, we gave up sanitizing in Path method. That's an unexpected behaviour - it breaks paths. We should sanitize everything as soon as we received. Most commands work with md5 hashes, for such cases no sanitize is needed 13.07.2024 gofumpt for stricter formatting. gofumpt is happy with a subset of the formats that gofmt is happy with. The less we have to choose between different formating options, the better 13.07.2024 FS's structure should have userFS name, to reflect the fact it user user-namespaced 09.07.2024 Note term is way too vague. Let's try to use "file" term, without any high level abstraction (like note) 13.08.2024 Gave up on AST parsing/rendering. We had lots of corner cases via AST and the code was way complex. Markdown isn't that hard to parse, we can do it via good old straigforward code. We have 3x times less code now, and it is far less mentally taxing to understand. We did the same for MD->HTML conversion. Telegram doesn't support whole range of HTML tags, so it was easier to write our own md-to-html converter. 08.07.2024 Adherence to Tolerant Reader principles. If enconunter gibberish during parsing - we skip it, but if we encounter flags of valid data (let's say ###) but data itself is invalid - we panic. TODO preserve gibberish during read-write cycle. 07.07.2024 Usage of https://github.com/rivo/uniseg. In Go, strings are read-only slices of bytes. They can be turned into Unicode code points using the for loop or by casting: []rune(str). However, multiple code points may be combined into one user-perceived character or what the Unicode specification calls "grapheme cluster". For example, white circle "⚪" has two runes, but one grapheme cluster. 07.09.2024 Markdown to HTML conversion. User can have invalid Markdown in his notes, and TG API would fail to send invalid Markdown directly. So, first we escape HTML, then we convert user's Markdown to HTML and finally send it via Telegram API as HTML. 13.06.2023 File hashing. Everywhere where we have user input - we should use fs.hash, otherwise we get long filenames, and tg returns INVALID_DATA error (callbackData max 64 bytes) 13.06.2023 Introduced db.go. We had to abstract away Redis anyway (otherwise it's hard to write tests) 13.03.2023 Package db.go doesn't store userID (we often use it separately...) Do we? Maybe we gonna use it without userID (like global bot stats?). Added: moved userID to class. Maybe in later we'll need this class outside of user's scope, but let's stay in the future 😃 13.06.2023 We can't ucfist filename in fs.Put - what if that was user-created file (outside the bot), i.e. it comes with lowercase

articles.title: Lost Images from the 1945 Trinity Nuclear Test Restored
author: [[pseudolus]]
articles.description: Article URL: https://spectrum.ieee.org/trinity-nuclear-test Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48220639 Points: 321 # Comments: 98
articles.tldr: 通过20年修复，Emily Seyl新书公开数百张1945年三位一体核试验高清照片
articles.objective_summary: Emily Seyl著作《Trinity: An Illustrated History of the World's First Atomic Test》（芝加哥大学出版社）基于20年修复工作，公布了数百张1945年7月16日三位一体核试验的清晰照片。
key_logic_flow: Emily Seyl的新书《Trinity: An Illustrated History of the World's First Atomic Test》经20年照片修复，公布了数百张曼哈顿计划期间三位一体核试验的生动影像。
1945年7月16日5时29分45秒（山区战时时间），人类首次核裂变链式反应在新疆西哥州Jornada del Muerto盆地引爆，标志核时代开启。
摄影师Berlyn Brixner在North 10,000摄影地堡中使用Mitchell电影摄影机和Fastax高速摄影机拍摄，记录了火球在不到百分之一秒内从黑暗中爆出的全过程。
52台摄影机中仅11台产出合格图像，但Spectrographic and Photographic Measurements Group通过错位布设不同距离、角度和帧率的设备，仍拼凑出完整的爆炸时序记录。
爆炸实际威力远超预期，大量摄影和诊断仪器被冲击波摧毁；目击者描述强光'震撼人心'，爆炸轰鸣'似乎永远不会离开'。
摄影组负责人Julian Mack指出，超过10万帧拍摄画面仍无法呈现爆炸的真实亮度和时空尺度，爆炸的视觉冲击远超任何照片或文字所能描述。

articles.title: SBCL: the ultimate assembly code breadboard (2014)
author: [[yacin]]
articles.description: Article URL: https://pvk.ca/Blog/2014/03/15/sbcl-the-ultimate-assembly-code-breadboard/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48209558 Points: 132 # Comments: 7
articles.tldr: 使用SBCL汇编器快速原型化8槽位堆栈虚拟机
articles.objective_summary: 作者受F18处理器和x87栈启发，使用SBCL的汇编器在REPL中构建了一个8槽位循环堆栈虚拟机，通过模8计数器实现零数据移动的栈操作，并为每个栈指针值生成专门指令变体，最终实现100万次循环仅需6.18M周期。
key_logic_flow: 作者受Chuck Moore的F18处理器（仅10个堆栈槽位，无溢出陷阱）和x87浮点栈的启发，设计了一个8槽位循环堆栈虚拟机。
虚拟机通过模8计数器实现栈顶指针，push/pop仅增减计数器不移动数据，并为每个栈指针值（共8种）生成专门的指令变体，间距4288字节。
作者使用SBCL的汇编器（sb-assem）和SLIME REPL生成并测试虚拟机代码，将r8-r15寄存器映射为堆栈槽位。
实现了enter/leave（CL调用接口）、lit/inc/dec（立即数）、swap/drop/add/sub、jmp/jnz/jz控制流以及call/ret等基本指令。
通过融合指令（djn将dec+jnz合并）和用条件跳转替代条件移动，将100万次递减循环从15M周期逐步优化至6.18M周期。

key_logic_flow: 作者每年有一半时间在马赛马拉拍摄大量视频素材，另一半时间在终端前编程，视频素材因缺乏编辑时间而堆积。
作者最初考虑使用SaaS AI视频编辑方案（Eddie AI、Higgsfield MCP等，月费约140美元），但发现这些工具需要素材已标注标签，无法直接处理未标注的原始视频。
作者转而构建本地优先的视频索引系统：核心思路是先为每个视频建立索引（.description.md侧边文件），让素材可被自然语言查询，再叠加AI编辑。
系统流水线包括：ffprobe提取元数据、exiftool读取GPS信息、ffmpeg抽取5帧、WhisperX多语言转录和说话人分离、insightface人脸识别、Gemma 4 31B视觉模型一次性生成完整描述（含评分、技术质量、光照、色彩、关键词等）。

开发过程中遇到4个关键bug：WhisperX API接口变更、Claude CLI权限错误返回成功响应、Gemma返回字符串而非整数字段、视频筛选标准需从"技术完美"调整为"记忆保留"。

articles.title: Show HN: Freenet, a peer-to-peer platform for decentralized apps
author: [[sanity]]
articles.description: For the past 5 years or so I've been working on a ground-up redesign of Freenet, my peer-to-peer project from the early 2000s (now renamed Hyphanet).The new Freenet has been up and running since December along with some early applications like River[1], our decentralized group chat and Delta - a decentralized CMS. Users have already started to build their own apps on Freenet including games, and we have some interesting apps in development like Atlas, a search/recommendation engine.Architecturally, this new Freenet is a global, decentralized key-value store where keys are webassembly contracts which define what values (aka "state") are valid for that key, how or when the values can be mutated, and how the state can be efficiently synchronized between peers.We've developed a unique (AFAIK) solution to the consistency problem, every contract must define a "merge" operation for the contract's associated state. This operation must be commutative, meaning that you can merge multiple states in any order and you'll get the same end result.This approach allows state updates to spread through the network like a virus[2], which typically achieves consistent global state in a few seconds or less.Like the world wide web, Freenet applications can be downloaded from the network itself and run in a web browser - similar to single-page apps on the normal web. However, rather than connecting back to an API running in a datacenter, the webapp connects locally to the Freenet peer and interacts with Freenet contracts and delegates over a local websocket connection.If you'd like to try Freenet we have convenient installers for the major desktop OSs but not yet mobile, and you can be chatting with other users on River within seconds[3]. Happy to answer any questions, you're also welcome to read our FAQ[4], or watch a talk I gave back in March[5].[1] https://github.com/freenet/river[2] https://freenet.org/about/news/summary-delta-sync/[3] https://freenet.org/quickstart/[4] https://freenet.org/faq/[5] https://youtu.be/3SxNBz1VTE0 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48223362 Points: 252 # Comments: 137

articles.title: Uv is fantastic, but its package management UX is a mess
author: [[nchagnet]]
articles.description: Article URL: https://www.loopwerk.io/articles/2026/uv-ux-mess/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48228788 Points: 146 # Comments: 85
articles.tldr: 批评 uv 包管理器在项目维护阶段的 CLI 用户体验问题，包括缺少独立 outdated 命令、默认无版本上限、升级命令繁琐。
articles.objective_summary: loopwerk.io 作者发文指出 Astral 的 uv 包管理器在项目维护阶段存在严重的 CLI 用户体验问题：缺少独立的 outdated 命令、默认依赖版本无上限导致升级不安全、升级命令需要重复指定 --upgrade-package 参数。
key_logic_flow: uv 没有独立的 outdated 命令，必须使用 uv tree --outdated --depth 1，且输出包含所有顶层依赖而非仅过时的依赖列表。
uv 默认添加依赖时不设版本上限（如 pydantic>=2.13.4），允许大版本跳跃，更新不安全。
pnpm 和 Poetry 默认使用语义化版本约束（如 ^1.23.4 或 >=1.23.4,<2.0.0），更新默认安全。
uv 的升级命令 uv lock --upgrade 是核选项，会无差别升级所有包到最新版本，可能引入深层嵌套依赖的破坏性变更。
uv 的 --upgrade-package 参数需要为每个包重复指定，无法像 pnpm update pydantic httpx 那样批量简洁更新。
uv 已推出 --bounds major 预览选项用于设置版本上限，但目前仍为 opt-in 模式，非默认行为。

key_logic_flow: 低视力用户Veroniiiica因传统搜索引擎结果页面视觉杂乱（AI摘要、广告、自动播放内容）导致视觉疲劳加重，转而使用Kagi付费搜索引擎。
Kagi是由用户订阅而非广告资助的付费搜索引擎，搜索结果页面无广告、无追踪、无赞助结果，靠质量而非SEO关键词排序。
Kagi提供多种订阅方案：试用版（100次免费搜索）、Starter（5美元/月，300次搜索）、Professional（10美元/月，无限搜索）、Ultimate（25美元/月，含Research模式AI助手），并有公平定价政策。
Kagi提供Lenses（筛选过滤器）、Bangs（快速跳转搜索）、域名屏蔽/提升/置顶等搜索自定义工具，并能整合博客和非商业性小型网络内容。
Kagi的可访问性设置包括主题（浅色/深色）、字体大小（Small到Larger）、结果对齐方式（左对齐/居中）、URL显示样式和位置等，可降低低视力用户的视觉疲劳。
Kagi可在Chrome、Edge、Firefox等主流浏览器中设为默认搜索引擎，支持浏览器扩展安装和手动配置两种方式。

key_logic_flow: Inkwell for iOS（Micro.blog 的 RSS 阅读器配套应用）于 2026 年 4 月 21 日提交至 Apple 审核，遭遇连续多次拒审。
Apple 以 1.2、2.1(a)、2.1(b)、3.1、4、5.1.1(v)、5.2.5 等多条审核准则要求修改，涉及内容举报、登录按钮修复、收入说明、UI 设计、账户删除功能等。
为满足 3.1 条款（避免应用内购买抽成），开发者移除了发帖、高亮等创作功能，并将应用仅在美国区上架。
主要障碍来自 5.2.5 条款：Apple 认为 Inkwell 名称侵犯其商标权，但该商标（2002 年 Mac OS X 手写识别功能）已被 USPTO 标注为死亡状态。
开发者已向 Apple 审核委员会上诉，仍在等待结果；同期 Android 版本已于 4 月通过 Google 审核无问题。

articles.title: Saying goodbye to asm.js
author: [[eqrion]]
articles.description: Article URL: https://spidermonkey.dev/blog/2026/05/20/saying-goodbye-to-asmjs.html Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48206340 Points: 333 # Comments: 137
articles.tldr: Firefox 148 起 SpiderMonkey 默认关闭 asm.js 优化，未来版本将完全移除。
articles.objective_summary: Mozilla 在 Firefox 148 中默认禁用 SpiderMonkey 的 asm.js 优化路径，计划在未来版本中彻底移除相关代码。asm.js 曾是 Mozilla 为在 Web 上运行原生速度代码而提出的方案，后成为 WebAssembly 的前身。官方建议仍在使用 asm.
key_logic_flow: Firefox 148 起，SpiderMonkey 默认禁用 asm.js 优化，未来版本将完全移除相关代码。
asm.js 仍作为普通 JavaScript 子集通过常规 JIT 正常运行，不会导致现有网站崩溃。
asm.js 是 Mozilla 为回应 NaCl/PNaCl 而提出的方案，通过选取 JavaScript 严格静态类型子集实现接近原生的执行速度。
asm.js 于 2013 年在 Firefox 22 中发布，成功让 Unity 和 Unreal 等 C/C++ 项目首次通过标准 Web 技术运行在浏览器中。
asm.js 验证了 Web 技术可实现接近原生的运行速度，为后续 WebAssembly 在 Firefox 52 中的发布铺平了道路。
保留 asm.js 代码路径带来维护成本和额外攻击面，而 WebAssembly 已成功替代其功能，这是关闭 asm.js 优化的直接原因。

articles.title: Seattle Shield, an intelligence-sharing network operated by the Seattle police
author: [[root-parent]]
articles.description: Article URL: https://prismreports.org/2026/05/20/seattle-shield-private-companies-surveillance/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48226588 Points: 444 # Comments: 175
articles.tldr: 西雅图警方运营的 Seattle Shield 情报共享网络将 Facebook、亚马逊、ICE 等公私机构连接至反恐监控体系，引发隐私担忧。
articles.objective_summary: Prism Reports 通过公开记录请求披露，西雅图警察局自 2009 年起运营 Seattle Shield 情报共享网络，成员包括 Facebook、亚马逊、ICE、FBI 等公私机构。该网络在反恐名义下收集抗议活动情报，2025 年报告几乎全部聚焦抗议与交通延误。

companies: American Civil Liberties Union of Washington

key_logic_flow: Seattle Shield 是西雅图警察局自 2009 年起运营的私有情报共享网络，成员涵盖 Facebook、亚马逊、ICE、FBI 等公私机构，以反恐为名义运作。
Prism Reports 通过公开记录请求获取了截至 2020 年的完整成员名单以及 2020–2025 年间的通报文件，发现 2025 年的通报几乎全部涉及抗议活动和潜在交通延误。
该网络鼓励私企提交可疑活动报告，信息汇入全国性执法监控体系，可能被用于将受宪法保护的抗议言论标记为恐怖主义威胁。
长期隐私活动人士 Phil Mocek 指出，该网络缺乏有效的监督、追踪和审计机制，信息共享路径不透明。
Seattle Shield 效仿 2005 年 9/11 后成立的 NYPD Shield 模式，各地独立运营，由 Global Shield Network 作为松散联盟串联。
Prism 未发现 Seattle Shield 曾公开宣称其情报直接导致任何恐怖主义逮捕的证据，FBI 拒绝确认该网络是否曾促成恐怖主义相关逮捕。

articles.title: Show HN: I reverse engineered Apple's video wallpapers
author: [[kageroumado]]
articles.description: Ever since Apple introduced their video wallpapers I wanted to be able to put custom videos there. I decided to reverse engineer and see what I can do.I built Phosphene to sell it, but the existing competitors were polished enough that the time it would have taken to catch up wasn't going to pay off. So I'm open-sourcing it.WallpaperExtensionKit.framework is what powers macOS wallpapers. It controls what’s shows in the Settings app. It took a lot of trial and error to replicate the behavior, but the result is that your custom wallpapers appear alongside everything else. I wanted to have an “add” button there too, but I couldn’t find a way to do so, so there’s a companion app that will put your video where it needs to be.Unlike Apple's Aerials, the video keeps playing on the desktop (not just the lock screen). The renderer drives AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer directly with PTS-offset gapless looping, and pauses or downshifts based on thermal state, battery level, brightness, and window occlusion.It’s free and works well. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48215979 Points: 110 # Comments: 30
articles.tldr: Phosphene 开源发布，逆向苹果私有框架实现 macOS 视频壁纸引擎。
articles.objective_summary: 开发者 @kageroumado 逆向苹果私有 WallpaperExtensionKit 框架，构建并开源了 Phosphene——一款 macOS Tahoe 菜单栏视频壁纸引擎，支持 MP4/MOV 文件作为桌面和锁屏壁纸，具备多显示器、功耗感知播放、无间隙循环等特性。
key_logic_flow: Phosphene 通过 dlopen 加载苹果私有的 WallpaperExtensionKit 框架，利用 Mirror 运行时反射与 XPC 类型通信，实现视频壁纸播放。
项目包含菜单栏应用和壁纸扩展两部分，扩展运行在系统 WallpaperAgent 进程中，通过 XPC 接收 acquire/update/invalidate/snapshot 调用。
视频渲染使用 AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer 替代 AVPlayerLayer（后者在远程 CAContext 中静默失败），通过预加载下一循环和 PTS 偏移实现无间隙循环。
PlaybackPolicy 根据热状态、电池电量、演示模式、窗口遮挡等输入动态将播放质量调整为 full/reduced/minimal/paused 四档。
项目支持多显示器独立壁纸、自适应变体渲染、锁屏渐入渐出过渡、窗口遮挡暂停以及菜单栏控制等高级特性。
该项目最初为商业项目，因市场竞争激烈而转为开源发布，基于 MIT 许可证。

articles.title: Throwing AI-generated walls of text into conversations
author: [[napolux]]
articles.description: Article URL: https://noslopgrenade.com/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48219992 Points: 553 # Comments: 326
articles.tldr: 批评将AI生成的长篇文本直接粘贴到日常对话中，认为这会摧毁沟通本身。
articles.objective_summary: 作者指出，人们将AI生成的长篇回答粘贴到即时通讯或邮件中，替代原本一句话就能表达的人类回复。这种行为浪费接收者时间、扼杀对话、以帮助为名行攻击之实。作者主张用AI让表达更清晰而非更冗长。
key_logic_flow: 将AI生成的长篇文本直接粘贴到聊天或邮件中，替代人类本应一句话表达的回复，破坏了沟通媒介本身的特性。
接收方如果想看AI回答会直接去问ChatGPT，他们找你是为了你的人类判断，而非一份AI文档。
AI长篇回复窃取接收方时间，对方需要花大量精力从文本中提取本该直给的一句话答案。
即使回答技术上正确，但格式本身对人际沟通充满敌意，会扼杀对话，让接收者无法回应、反驳或澄清。
AI生成的长篇文本本质上是伪装成帮助的武器，应该用AI让表达更清晰而非更冗长，让AI辅助思考而非替代思考。

articles.tldr: Google在I/O大会宣布搜索全面转向AI生成答案，削弱链接呈现，被批为对开放网络的宣战。
articles.objective_summary: Google在2026年5月20日的I/O主题演讲中宣布进一步推动搜索向AI直接生成答案的方向演进，减少对网页链接的呈现。作者认为此举意味着Google在传统网页之上建立了一个由自己控制的抽象层，将网站内容视为免费的原材料，实际上垄断了信息访问入口。
key_logic_flow: Google在2026年I/O主题演讲中宣布搜索将进一步转向AI直接生成答案的模式，延续了AI Overviews的方向。
该模式大幅减少对原始网页链接的呈现，用户获取信息不再通过访问来源网站。
作者认为Google正在网页之上建立一个由其控制的抽象层，像围墙花园一样垄断信息访问。
网站创作者的劳动被降级为AI系统的免费训练原料，其作品不再作为独立的文化产物被分享和访问。
作者预测Google或类似公司未来会创造贬义标签来污名化开放网页，将其AI抽象层包装为所谓的安全网络。

articles.tldr: Meta应沙特和阿联酋政府要求，对人权组织及活动家账号实施地理封锁
articles.objective_summary: 2026年4月30日起，Meta应沙特和阿联酋政府要求，对ALQST等独立人权组织及活动家的Facebook和Instagram账号实施地理封锁。多个国际人权组织联合谴责Meta此举违反表达自由和国际人权责任。
key_logic_flow: 2026年4月30日起，Meta应沙特政府请求，对ALQST for Human Rights、Democratic Diwan等组织及沙特研究员Abdullah Alaoudh、人权捍卫者Yahya Assiri的Facebook账号在沙特境内实施地理封锁。
类似限制在阿联酋同步实施，包括针对一名学者的账号。X平台也收到沙特政府的类似地理封锁请求，截至5月20日尚未执行。

Meta援引沙特和阿联酋的网络犯罪法作为合规依据，称受限内容涉及'区域性地缘政治冲突和安全事态报道'。
多个国际人权组织联合声明，要求Meta公布完整的政府法律请求及其声称开展的人权影响评估详情。
签署方呼吁Meta立即恢复所有受影响账号的访问权限，并承诺以具体细节通知受影响用户哪些内容触发了限制及依据哪条法律。

articles.title: Google's AI is being manipulated. The search giant is quietly fighting back
author: [[tigerlily]]
articles.description: Article URL: https://www.bbc.com/future/article/20260519-google-tackles-attempts-to-hack-its-ai-results Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48205782 Points: 268 # Comments: 179
articles.tldr: BBC调查发现AI聊天机器人易被操纵传播虚假信息，Google已更新规则应对。
articles.objective_summary: BBC记者Thomas Germain通过发布一篇个人博客，在20分钟内成功操纵ChatGPT和Google AI Overviews传播其虚构的"世界热狗大赛冠军"身份，揭示AI工具易被单一网页内容操纵的问题。Google随后更新反垃圾政策，明确操纵AI回答属违规行为。
key_logic_flow: BBC记者Thomas Germain于2026年2月通过在其个人网站发布一篇"热狗大赛冠军"假文章，成功在20分钟内让ChatGPT和Google AI Overviews传播该虚假信息。
调查发现，AI工具在搜索互联网回答问题时容易从单一网页或社交媒体帖子中提取信息，导致系统易被操纵。
有公司利用这一漏洞系统性地操纵AI回答，涉及健康医疗和金融信息等严肃领域。
Google于2026年5月更新反垃圾政策，明确将操纵AI回答的行为列为违规，违规网站可能被降权或移除出搜索结果。
Google称该更新只是对现有政策的"澄清"而非改变，但专家观察到Google和ChatGPT正在试验移除自荐信息等隐性措施。
SEO专家指出Google面临"打地鼠"困境，操纵者已转向通过YouTube网红等更隐蔽方式继续操纵AI回答。

articles.title: Flipper One – we need your help
author: [[sandebert]]
articles.description: Article URL: https://blog.flipper.net/flipper-one-we-need-your-help/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48220647 Points: 1109 # Comments: 433
articles.tldr: Flipper 公布开源 Linux 硬件平台 Flipper One，与 Collabora 合作推进 RK3576 主线内核支持，
articles.objective_summary: Flipper 团队在官方博客公开了历时多年研发的 Flipper One 项目。该设备是基于 RK3576 SoC 和 RP2350 MCU 双处理器架构的开放式 Linux 硬件平台，支持 PCIe/USB 3.0/SATA 扩展及 5G 网络。
key_logic_flow: Flipper 宣布 Flipper One 项目，这不是 Flipper Zero 的升级版，而是一个全新的开放式 Linux 硬件平台，定位为网络层 IP 连接设备。
该设备采用双处理器架构：RK3576（8 核 CPU + Mali-G52 GPU + NPU）运行 Linux，RP2350 MCU 独立控制显示/按键/电源，即使主 CPU 关机也能操作。
Flipper 与 Collabora 合作将 Rockchip RK3576 SoC 完全支持推入主线 Linux 内核，目标是无二进制 blob、无闭源驱动、无厂商锁定的 BSP。
团队正在构建 Flipper OS——基于 Debian 的系统层，引入配置文件快照（profiles）机制，允许用户在不同预配置环境间自由切换。
同时开发 FlipCTL 框架，为小屏幕 Linux 设备提供菜单式界面，将 ping/nmap 等 CLI 工具封装为 D-pad 可导航的 UI。
Flipper 公开了开发者门户 wiki，任何人都可以编辑和参与硬件、机械、Linux 软件、MCU 固件、UI、文档、测试等子项目的开发。

articles.title: Blog ran on Ubuntu 16.04 for 10 years. I migrated it to FreeBSD
author: [[speckx]]
articles.description: Article URL: https://crocidb.com/post/this-blog-ran-on-ubuntu-16-04-for-10-years-i-migrated-it-to-freebsd/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48227397 Points: 224 # Comments: 119
articles.tldr: 博主将运行10年的Ubuntu 16.04服务器从DigitalOcean迁移至Hetzner并改用FreeBSD系统
articles.objective_summary: 作者将其运行超过10年的DigitalOcean VPS（Ubuntu 16.04 LTS，纽约机房，$13/月）迁移至Hetzner VPS（FreeBSD 14.3，德国机房，€5.99/月），旧服务器曾持续运行1491天未中断。新架构使用FreeBSD Jails配合Bastille管理实现站
key_logic_flow: 作者的个人博客在DigitalOcean的Ubuntu 16.04 LTS VPS上运行了超过10年，该系统已停止安全支持至少5年。
作者将服务器迁移至Hetzner的德国机房VPS，配置更高（4GB内存、2 vCPU、40GB磁盘）但价格更低（€5.99/月 vs $13/月）。
新系统选择FreeBSD 14.3，核心设计理念是利用FreeBSD Jails实现各站点的安全隔离，每个站点运行在独立的Jail中。
使用Bastille工具管理Jails的生命周期（创建、启动、控制台访问等），替代手动创建Jail的复杂步骤。
网络架构中，Caddy运行在一个独立Jail中作为反向代理网关，处理所有HTTP/HTTPS流量并自动管理SSL证书，再将请求转发至各站点Jail。
通过PF（Packet Filter）配置NAT和端口转发规则，设置虚拟网络接口bastille0供Jails使用，实现内部网络隔离与外部访问。

author: [[jaredwiener]]

articles.tldr: 超340家美国地方新闻媒体限制互联网档案馆爬取其内容，防止AI公司通过后门抓取训练数据。
articles.objective_summary: 2026年5月，Nieman Lab分析发现382家新闻网站通过robots.txt限制互联网档案馆的爬虫访问，其中342家为地方媒体。出版商采取预防性封锁，担忧AI公司通过Archive的仓库抓取其内容用于模型训练，尚无证据表明已发生实际抓取。
key_logic_flow: 2026年1月Nieman Lab首次披露主要新闻出版商开始封锁互联网档案馆，5个月后封锁站点数量持续上升。
超过340家美国地方新闻网站加入了封锁行列，隶属于USA Today Co.、McClatchy、Advance Local、MediaNews Group和Tribune Publishing五大出版商。
Advance Local自2025年8月起开始封锁互联网档案馆，系预防性措施，无证据表明其内容已被AI公司通过Wayback Machine抓取。
Alden Global Capital旗下约60家媒体集团和7家论坛出版报纸同步实施了封锁，该公司此前曾公开批评AI公司未经补偿使用新闻内容。
部分独立出版商（如The Baltimore Banner）更关注AI产品能否正确归因回原文，而非完全禁止AI访问，仍保留与AI公司沟通的开放态度。
国际出版商如巴西最大报纸Folha de S.Paulo也加入封锁，强调AI公司若需使用存档进行训练应签订授权协议。

articles.title: Incident Report: May 19, 2026 – GCP Account Suspension
author: [[0xedb]]
articles.description: Previous thread: Incident Report: Railway Blocked by Google Cloud [resolved] - https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48201484 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48204770 Points: 396 # Comments: 238
articles.tldr: Railway 因 GCP 错误暂停账户导致全平台宕机约 8 小时
articles.objective_summary: 2026年5月19日22:20 UTC，Google Cloud 自动错误地将 Railway 的生产账户标记为暂停状态，导致 Railway 在 GCP 上的 API、控制面板和数据库离线。路由缓存过期后，AWS 和 Railway Metal 上的全部工作负载也相继不可用。
key_logic_flow: 2026年5月19日22:20 UTC，Google Cloud 自动错误地将 Railway 的生产账户置于暂停状态，导致 Railway 在 GCP 上的 API、控制面板、数据库及所有计算基础设施离线。
Railway 的边缘代理依赖 GCP 托管的控制平面 API 填充路由表，GCP 宕机约一小时后路由缓存过期，AWS 和 Railway Metal 上的工作负载因无法解析路由而返回 404 错误，宕机影响波及全平台。
恢复 GCP 账户访问后，持久磁盘、计算实例和网络需逐一恢复，磁盘在 23:54 UTC 恢复就绪，但核心网络和边缘路由直到次日 01:30 UTC 才完全恢复。
恢复过程中 GitHub 因重试请求激增对 Railway 的 OAuth 和 Webhook 集成实施速率限制，导致用户登录和构建功能受阻。
Railway 承认其架构存在单点依赖——工作负载发现能力绑定在 GCP 托管的控制平面 API 上，计划移除该依赖以构建真正的多云网状网络。
Railway 计划将高可用数据库分片扩展到 AWS 和 Metal，并将 GCP 从数据平面热路径中移除，仅保留作为次要/故障转移用途。

articles.title: OlmoEarth v1.1: A more efficient family of Earth observation models
articles.tldr: Allen AI 发布 OlmoEarth v1.1，计算成本降低最多 3 倍
articles.objective_summary: Allen Institute for AI 发布 OlmoEarth v1.1 模型族，通过优化 token 序列长度将卫星影像推理的计算成本降低最多 3 倍，同时保持与 v1 版本相当的基准性能。该模型采用基于分辨率块的 token 化策略处理 Sentinel-2 多时相数据。
key_logic_flow: Allen AI 于 2025 年 11 月发布 OlmoEarth v1，已在 mangrove 变化追踪、森林损失分类和国家尺度作物类型制图等任务中得到应用
OlmoEarth v1.1 将计算成本降低最多 3 倍，同时保持与 v1 相同的性能，以降低卫星影像大规模部署的门槛
Transformer 模型的计算成本与 token 序列长度呈二次方关系，因此减小序列长度是提升效率的关键杠杆
OlmoEarth 对 Sentinel-2 影像采用基于分辨率块的 token 化策略：每个空间块（p×p）按时间步和三种分辨率（10m/20m/60m）分别生成 token
模型提供多种尺寸供用户根据计算预算选择，以平衡效率与分析精度

articles.title: Import AI 457: AI stuxnet; cursed Muon optimizer; and positive alignment
author: [[Jack Clark]]
articles.description: Welcome to Import AI, a newsletter about AI research.
articles.tldr: SentinelOne发现20年前病毒fast16.sys，通过篡改高精度计算结果可能用于破坏核武研发。
articles.objective_summary: SentinelOne研究人员分析了一个20多年前的病毒fast16.sys，该病毒通过篡改内存中的浮点运算指令，针对性破坏LS-DYNA 970、PKPM和MOHID等高精度工程仿真软件的计算结果，可能旨在破坏伊朗核武器开发项目。
key_logic_flow: SentinelOne研究人员对20多年前的计算机病毒fast16.sys进行了技术拆解分析。
该病毒专门针对高精度计算软件，通过修改内存中的x86代码和浮点运算指令来篡改计算结果。
病毒注入了一段独立的浮点运算函数，专门用于干扰内部数组的精度运算和缩放计算。
YARA签名扫描发现该病毒只感染了极少数文件，均为土木工程、物理和物理过程模拟领域的高精度计算工具。
被锁定的三个主要软件是LS-DYNA 970（核武器模拟）、PKPM（结构分析）和MOHID（环境建模），其中LS-DYNA曾被报道用于伊朗核武器研发。
该病毒框架通过引入系统性微小计算误差，可达到破坏科学研究、降低工程系统可靠性乃至引发灾难性后果的目的。

articles.title: Latest open artifacts (#21): Open model bonanza! Gemma 4, DeepSeek V4, Kimi K2.6, MiMo 2.5, GLM-5.1 & others. On CAISI's V4 assessment.
author: [[Florian Brand]]
articles.description: An eventful month with one flagship release after another
articles.tldr: DeepSeek V4等多款开源模型密集发布，CAISI评测认为开源模型落后美国前沿且差距扩大，Interconnects质疑评测方法
articles.objective_summary: 2026年5月，DeepSeek V4、Gemma 4、Kimi K2.6、MiMo 2.5、GLM-5.1等多款开源模型密集发布。CAISI基于IRT的Elo评分对DeepSeek V4进行评估，认为开源模型落后美国前沿且差距随时间扩大。Interconnects作者指出评测方法（固定token预
key_logic_flow: DeepSeek V4、Gemma 4、Kimi K2.6、MiMo 2.5、GLM-5.1 等开源前沿模型在本月密集发布。
CAISI 基于项目反应理论（IRT）计算 Elo 评分，使用 9 种不同基准评测 DeepSeek V4，结论是开源模型落后于美国闭源前沿且差距在扩大。
DeepSeek V4 的 Elo 分差主要由 CTF-Archive-Diamond（子集+IRT外推）、PortBench（CAISI 私有基准）和 ARC-AGI-2（不同评分方法）三个基准上的低分造成。
Epoch AI 的 ECI 指标显示，自 R1 以来开源与闭源模型差距稳定在 3-7 个月。
Interconnects 作者认为 CAISI 和 ECI 均使用标准化简化设置（如编程任务用 bash+固定 token 预算而非 Claude Code 或 OpenCode），不能反映模型真实能力。
Interconnects 内部存在分歧：Florian 认为开源模型在实际性能上更接近闭源模型，Nathan 认为闭源模型领先更多。

articles.title: How to Deploy Your First App on FastAPI Cloud
author: [[Abid Ali Awan]]
articles.description: Learn how to build, test, deploy, and monitor your first FastAPI Cloud app, a simple live gold and silver dashboard.
articles.tldr: 教程演示如何通过 CLI 在几秒内将 FastAPI 应用部署到 FastAPI Cloud。
articles.objective_summary: 作者以搭建贵金属价格实时看板为例，演示了从创建 FastAPI 项目、添加 httpx 依赖、编写获取黄金/白银价格的 API 与 HTML 前端，到使用 fastapi deploy 命令部署至 FastAPI Cloud 并获取公网 URL 的完整流程。
key_logic_flow: FastAPI Cloud 是一个托管平台，通过 CLI 工具提供快速部署能力，作者通过 waitlist 获得访问权限后撰写了本教程。
使用 uvx fastapi-new metals-live 命令可快速生成 FastAPI 项目脚手架并自动安装依赖。
示例应用是一个实时贵金属价格看板，使用 httpx 异步请求 Gold API 获取黄金和白银价格，通过 /api/prices 返回 JSON，并在根路径提供自动每 15 秒刷新的 HTML 界面。
运行 fastapi dev main.py 可启动本地开发服务器进行测试，支持交互式 API 文档页面。
运行 fastapi deploy 命令后，CLI 引导完成账户连接和配置，自动构建部署并生成公网 URL（如 metals-live.fastapicloud.dev）。
部署后可通过 FastAPI Cloud 仪表盘查看应用日志和集成配置，平台体验类似于 Supabase 和 Vercel。

articles.title: 7 Practical Ways to Reduce Claude Code Token Usage
author: [[Kanwal Mehreen]]
articles.description: Claude Code token costs usually come from bloated context, not just long prompts. These 7 practical tactics help reduce waste without hurting quality.
articles.tldr: 7种减少Claude Code令牌消耗的实用方法，核心是控制上下文架构而非优化提示词。
articles.objective_summary: 技术作者Kanwal Mehreen发表了一篇指南，介绍7种减少Claude Code令牌消耗的实用方法：按任务复杂度切换模型（Opus/Sonnet/Haiku）、精简CLAUDE.md、用子代理隔离冗余输出、精确指定文件路径和行号、主动使用/compact压缩会话、通过/context检查上下文
key_logic_flow: Claude Code的令牌消耗主要源于会话上下文中累积的历史消息、已读文件、工具输出和背景指令，而非用户的单次提示词。
按任务复杂度切换模型可大幅节省成本：Opus每令牌成本是Sonnet的5倍，日常任务应默认使用Sonnet，复杂任务用Opus，重复性机械任务用Haiku。
CLAUDE.md文件在会话期间始终驻留上下文窗口且不会被淘汰，过大的CLAUDE.md会在每次交互中浪费大量令牌，应保持精简、像查找表而非脑图。
子代理在独立上下文窗口中运行，只有摘要返回主会话，适合隔离冗长输出；但对简单任务因架构开销反而更浪费，需权衡使用场景。
精确指定目标文件和行号比模糊指令（如"看看代码有什么问题"）能显著减少令牌浪费；使用Shift+Tab的计划模式可避免试错式执行造成的累积开销。
应在会话"健康"时主动执行/compact压缩，而非等到上下文警告出现时才被动操作，提前压缩生成的摘要更干净、保留关键信息、丢弃噪声。

articles.title: 7 OpenCode Plugins That Make AI Coding More Powerful
author: [[Abid Ali Awan]]

Websearch Cited 插件在 OpenCode 中添加带引用来源和行内引用的网络搜索工具，支持 Google、OpenAI 或 OpenRouter 搜索配置。
Wakatime 插件追踪 AI 辅助的编码活动、耗时和文件变更，集成 WakaTime 仪表盘；Agent Skills 插件支持从项目目录和 Claude 兼容位置加载可重用技能。

articles.title: Abacus AI Review: Honest Breakdown of Features, AI Agents & Automation
author: [[KDnuggets]]
articles.description: A detailed Abacus AI review covering ChatLLM, Abacus AI Agent, Claw, automation, app building, image and video generation, pricing, pros, cons, and who should use it.
articles.tldr: Abacus AI 是一个集聊天、研究、编码、应用构建和自动化于一体的统一 AI 平台。
articles.objective_summary: Abacus AI 发布了集 ChatLLM、Abacus AI Agent、Abacus Claw 于一体的统一 AI 平台，提供多模型访问、复杂任务执行、持久化代理和应用构建功能，月费约 20 美元/席位，面向创始人和开发者等重度用户。
key_logic_flow: Abacus AI 是一个将聊天、深度研究、编码、应用构建、视频生成和自动化整合于一体的统一 AI 平台，旨在替代多个独立 AI 工具的订阅和切换。
ChatLLM 是平台的交互层，提供对 GPT-5.5、Claude 4.6、Gemini 3.1 等多种前沿和开源模型的统一访问，用户无需在不同 AI 订阅间切换。
Abacus AI Agent（原 DeepAgent）是执行层，可完成深度研究、网站部署、应用构建、Google Workspace 自动化等多步骤复杂任务，输出完成品而非仅提供建议。
Abacus Claw 是持久化代理层，可在 Slack、WhatsApp、Telegram 等消息应用中持续运行并保持记忆，无需每次启动新会话。
Vibe Coding 功能允许用户用自然语言描述需求，由 Abacus AI 自动构建、托管和部署网站、内部工具或原型 SaaS 产品。
该平台面向创始人、开发者、分析师等重度用户，采用积分计费系统，功能丰富但学习曲线较陡。

articles.title: Baptists and Bootleggers: The Hidden Coalition Behind 'Data-Driven' Decisions
author: [[Nahla Davies]]
articles.description: One is genuine curiosity. The other is someone who already knows what they want and went looking for a number to back it up.
articles.tldr: 经济学的"禁酒贩与浸信会"框架揭示了数据驱动决策中真诚派与操纵派的隐秘联盟。
articles.objective_summary: Nahla Davies在KDnuggets发表分析文章，运用Bruce Yandle于1983年提出的"Bootleggers and Baptists"（禁酒贩与浸信会）经济学框架，揭示了组织中数据驱动决策的两类参与者：真心相信数据决策的"浸信会"和已预设结论、反向操纵数据的"禁酒贩"，
key_logic_flow: Bruce Yandle于1983年提出"Bootleggers and Baptists"理论，原用于解释美国南方周日禁酒令中道德派（浸信会）和牟利派（禁酒贩）因不同动机支持同一政策的联盟现象。
在数据驱动决策的组织中，"浸信会"是真正相信数据证据、愿意根据数据改变观点的人，视数据为照亮真相的手电筒。
在数据驱动决策的组织中，"禁酒贩"是已预设结论、反向操纵数据叙事的人，通过挑选时间范围、有利指标和忽略反证来包装既定决策。
两类人使用相同的"数据驱动"语言，从外部几乎无法区分，但浸信会为禁酒贩提供了道德合法性和政治掩护。
区分两者的关键在于观察当数据与预期结果矛盾时的反应：浸信会追问并可能改变方向，禁酒贩则转移话题或变换指标。
防范该联盟的最佳方法是不仅追问"数据说了什么"，还要追问"为什么是这些数据"以及"谁从决策中获益"。

articles.title: Testing SQL Like a Software Engineer: Unit Testing, CI/CD, and Data Quality Automation
author: [[Nate Rosidi]]
articles.description: How to turn an interview-style SQL query into a production-ready, testable, version-controlled workflow.
articles.tldr: 介绍如何对 SQL 进行单元测试、CI/CD 自动化以及数据质量验证的完整工作流。
articles.objective_summary: KDnuggets 发表了一篇技术教程，以亚马逊面试题为例，演示了将 SQL 封装为 Python 函数、用 unittest 和 SQLite 内存数据库进行单元测试、通过 GitHub Actions 自动化测试流程，以及实施数据质量监控的方法。
key_logic_flow: 文章以亚马逊面试题（查找指定日期范围内每日消费最高的客户）为案例，展示了3层SQL查询逻辑：按客户+日期聚合消费额、按日期排名、返回每日第一名。
将SQL查询封装为Python函数，使用unittest框架编写单元测试，通过SQLite内存数据库（:memory:）创建隔离的测试环境，加载控制数据集后比对查询结果与预期输出。
在GitHub仓库中创建.github/workflows/test_sql.yml工作流文件，配置在push到main分支或提交PR时自动触发测试。
CI流程包括：检出代码、配置Python 3.10环境、安装Pandas等依赖、通过python -m unittest discover自动发现并运行所有单元测试。
单元测试逐行验证查询结果的客户姓名、订单日期、聚合成本等字段，任何字段不匹配则标记测试失败，确保SQL逻辑回归被及时发现。

articles.title: Anonymizing Production Data for Data Science with Mimesis
author: [[Iván Palomares Carrascosa]]
articles.description: Learn how to utilize Python's Mimesis library for anonymizing sensitive production data, based on a step-by-step example to try yourself.
articles.tldr: Mimesis 是一个开源 Python 库，用于生成逼真的假数据以匿名化生产数据中的 PII。
articles.objective_summary: 本文介绍如何使用 Python 的 Mimesis 库对生产数据进行匿名化处理。通过一个分层订阅系统的客户数据集示例，演示了用 Mimesis 的 Person provider 生成假姓名、邮箱和电话号码，替换敏感的真实个人信息。
key_logic_flow: 生产数据通常涉及隐私和合规约束，匿名化处理是数据科学项目中的关键步骤。
Mimesis 是一个开源的 Python 库，可在本地运行，用于高性能生成逼真的假数据。
通过初始化 Mimesis 的 Person provider（指定语言和随机种子），可为敏感个人信息生成替代数据。
通过遍历 DataFrame 并调用 full_name()、email()、telephone() 等方法，替换真实姓名、邮箱和电话号码。
将替换后的列重命名（如 real_name 改为 anon_name），以标识数据已匿名化。
最终验证 DataFrame 确认所有 PII 字段已被替换为逼真的假数据。

articles.title: Top 10 Python Libraries for Data Engineering in 2026
author: [[Bala Priya C]]
articles.description: Want to level up your data engineering toolkit? Here are some Python libraries that'll make your pipelines faster, cleaner, and easier to maintain.
articles.tldr: KDnuggets 盘点 2026 年三大数据工程 Python 库：Prefect、SQLMesh、dlt
articles.objective_summary: KDnuggets 于 2026 年发布文章，介绍三个 Python 数据工程库：Prefect（工作流编排与监控）、SQLMesh（SQL 转换管理与 CI/CD）、dlt（免连接器数据摄入）。每个库均列出核心功能并附学习资源链接。
key_logic_flow: 数据工程对管道速度、可靠性和可维护性的要求持续增长，Python 生态已扩展出多个超越传统工具的实用库。
Prefect 是一个现代工作流编排库，支持用纯 Python 装饰器定义可观测、可重试的管道组件，并提供 UI 用于监控运行和诊断故障。
SQLMesh 是一个开源数据转换框架，具备语义理解能力，能自动确定变更后需重建的模型，并支持在虚拟环境中测试。
SQLMesh 支持 DuckDB、Spark、BigQuery、Snowflake、Trino 等多个执行引擎。
dlt（data load tool）是一个开源 Python 库，可从任意源到任意目标构建数据摄入管道，自动生成和演化 schema，支持增量加载和去重。
dlt 附带不断增长的已验证源和目标库，只需几行 Python 代码即可接入。

key_logic_flow: Claude Code Channels 是 Anthropic 提供的功能，允许用户通过聊天平台（如 Discord）与本地运行的 Claude Code 会话交互。
设置前提条件包括：安装 Claude Code、拥有 Claude.ai Pro 或 Max 订阅、拥有 Discord 账号和桌面应用。

articles.title: 🥇Top AI Papers of the Week
articles.description: The Top AI Papers of the Week (May 11 - May 17)
articles.tldr: 本周 AI 论文：Lighthouse Attention 训练加速与 Grep 检索匹敌嵌入检索
articles.objective_summary: Nous Research 提出 Lighthouse Attention，一种训练专用注意力包装器，通过分层无梯度选择对称压缩查询/键/值加速长上下文训练，部署前移除包装器恢复标准注意力，实验显示训练更快且损失更低。另有一论文发现 Grep 文本搜索在合适 Agent Harness
key_logic_flow: Nous Research 提出 Lighthouse Attention，一种训练阶段专用的注意力包装器，通过分层无梯度选择机制对称压缩和解压缩查询、键、值，降低长上下文训练成本。
Lighthouse Attention 在训练末期通过短期恢复阶段移除，部署后的模型无需任何架构变更即可运行标准 SDPA 注意力。
初步实验表明，Lighthouse Attention 比全注意力基线训练更快、最终损失更低，在 512K 上下文下前向延迟加速达 21 倍。
另一论文《Is Grep All You Need?》发现，Grep 文本搜索在合适的 Agent Harness 包装下，在编码 Agent 任务中可匹敌嵌入检索。
该研究指出 Agent Harness 的设计对性能差异的贡献远大于检索原语的选择，大多数通常归因于嵌入检索的性能差异实际来自 Harness 设计。

articles.tldr: GPT-5.5 Pro编码速度比上代快40%，在演化模拟测试中显著领先其他模型
articles.objective_summary: 作者获得GPT-5.5.1早期访问权限并进行了编码测试。GPT-5.5 Pro用20分钟完成3D城镇演化模拟任务（GPT-5.4 Pro需33分钟），且是唯一真正模拟城镇随时间演化的模型。其他对比模型（o3、Kimi K2.6）仅能生成建筑替换。
key_logic_flow: 作者获得了GPT-5.5（具体版本为GPT-5.5.1）的早期访问权限，并对其进行了性能评测。
在编码测试中，作者要求多个AI模型构建一个从公元前3000年到公元3000年港口城镇演化的3D程序化生成模拟页面。
GPT-5.5 Pro是唯一实现真正城镇演化的模型，其他模型（包括o3、Kimi K2.6等）仅能生成随时间替换的建筑，而非动态演化。
GPT-5.5 Pro完成任务耗时20分钟，比前代GPT-5.4 Pro的33分钟快了约40%。
作者提出理解AI的三个互相关联的概念框架：模型（models，如GPT-5.5、Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1）、应用（apps，如ChatGPT网站、Claude Code、Codex）和工具集（harnesses，AI可用的工具及连接方式）。

articles.title: An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry
articles.description: An OpenAI model solved the 80-year-old unit distance problem, disproving a major conjecture in discrete geometry and marking a milestone in AI-driven mathematics.
articles.tldr: OpenAI 通用推理模型自主否定持续近 80 年的 Erdős 单位距离猜想，首次实现 AI 独立解决数学核心开放问题
articles.objective_summary: OpenAI 内部开发的通用推理模型自主证明了 Paul Erdős 在 1946 年提出的平面单位距离问题中，传统认为最优的正方形网格构造并非最佳，提供了一个在多项式级别上更优的无限族构造。该证明已通过外部数学家验证，Tim Gowers 等人撰写了配套论文阐述该论证。
key_logic_flow: Paul Erdős 在 1946 年提出平面单位距离问题：在平面上放置点集时，最多能有多少对点恰好相距单位距离，该问题成为组合几何学最著名的未解难题之一。
近 80 年来数学界普遍认为正方形网格构造是最大化单位距离对数量的最优方案。
OpenAI 的一个通用推理模型（非专为数学训练的专用系统）自主构造出无限族反例，在多项式级别上推翻了这一长期猜想。
该证明已被一组外部数学家验证，Fields 奖得主 Tim Gowers 在配套论文中称其为「AI 数学领域的一个里程碑」。
这是 AI 首次自主解决数学子领域中的一个核心开放问题，表明当前通用推理模型已具备独立产生原创数学思想并完成论证的能力。

articles.objective_summary: AdventHealth在全系统9个州的医院网络中部署ChatGPT for Healthcare，用于自动化文档处理和支持任务。该措施使临床医生行政任务耗时减少80%，每周为医护团队节省数小时，提升了临床容量和患者就医速度。

articles.tldr: 风行在线CEO易正朝：全员普及AI编程三年，利润增长超10倍，核心策略是"坚信AI不碰模型"。
articles.objective_summary: 2026年5月，风行在线CEO易正朝在量子位主办的AIGC2026峰会上分享公司AI转型经验。风行用三年时间让全员学习编程，定位为MaaS与大文娱之间的中间层连接者，不自行研发模型。公司利润增长超10倍，拥有超50万创作者，AI视频业务占比不到10%。易正朝警告AI会放大自嗨，交付结果才是检验标准。
key_logic_flow: 风行在线CEO易正朝在AIGC2026峰会演讲中提出，企业应"坚信AI，不碰模型"，定位为MaaS服务商与大文娱产业方之间的中间层连接者。
风行在线用三年时间推动全员学习编程，将AI编程能力从工程师推广至运营、市场、内容等非技术岗位，利润增长超10倍。
易正朝认为AI视频使制作成本从百万级降至万级，但月均上架超四万部作品导致供给极度过剩，出精品难度反而上升。
易正朝警告AI最大的副作用是放大"自嗨"，解药只有交付结果，企业不应追求成为超级员工的容器而应撬动群体智慧的众创杠杆。
风行在线定位为"第二名"企业——不是探路先锋也不是落伍观望者，而是看清方向后快速高性价比跟进的实践派。

articles.title: 太初元碁洪源：异构计算能力将成为未来AI算力基础设施的重要方向｜AIGC2026

articles.description: AI产业正在进入新一轮高强度算力周期
articles.tldr: 太初元碁：异构计算能力将是未来AI算力基础设施重要方向
articles.objective_summary: 在AIGC2026峰会上，太初元碁首席产品官洪源发表演讲，指出随着Agentic AI和Token经济加速发展，AI算力需解决大规模集群服务能力、计算效率和生态适配三大问题，异构计算能力将成为未来方向。
key_logic_flow: 2026年AI产业进入新一轮高强度算力周期，Token经济加速到来，Token成为AI时代核心消耗单位，全球智能算力预计以每年60%速度增长。
太初元碁首席产品官洪源指出，国产AI算力迎来新机遇，算力需从模型训练基础资源升级为贯穿全链路的新型基础设施。
AI算力面临三大关键问题：大规模万卡集群的服务能力、CPU与GPU异构协同的计算效率、以及软件生态的易用性适配。
Agent任务执行中GPU有效计算时间仅占约10%，大量时间消耗在CPU调度、通信和数据处理环节，需提升异构计算单元协同效率。
太初元碁基于高性能计算领域积累，在芯片设计中布局多种计算模块并通过片上网络互联，提升CPU与GPU等单元的协同效率。
未来AI算力将像Token经济中的'制氧机'，持续支撑模型、应用和行业场景运行。

articles.title: AI首次实现中国风光发电普查，北大、阿里达摩院研究登上《自然》
author: [[量子位的朋友们]]
articles.description: 加快实现‘双碳’目标。
articles.tldr: 北大与阿里达摩院用AI绘制中国首张高精度风光设施分布图，成果登上《自然》。
articles.objective_summary: 2026年5月20日，《自然》发表北大与阿里达摩院合作研究。团队基于达摩院自研AI模型，处理7.56TB开源卫星影像，识别全国1915个县的31.9万处光伏设施和9.16万台风机，并分析风光互补协同可提升新能源利用率、减少弃风弃光。
key_logic_flow: 研究团队基于达摩院自研AI模型，在云计算平台上处理了覆盖全国的7.56TB、0.5米级分辨率开源卫星影像，成功定位并识别出全国1915个县的31.9万处光伏设施和9.16万台风机。
这是中国首次掌握大规模、高精度的全国风光设施清单，为电网优化和环境评估提供了数据基础。
研究发现不同地区的风电与光伏发电在时间上具有较强互补潜力，跨区域协同配置可有效提升新能源消纳能力。
研究测算显示，在全国范围跨省协同条件下，可在现有风光装机基础上额外提升约1000亿千瓦时绿电消纳能力。
跨区域协同能够显著降低储能和系统调节压力，为跨省电力交易和基础设施建设计划提供理论参考。

articles.title: VC、品牌顾问、编剧，正在批量把自己做成AI

articles.objective_summary: 5月19日，未来式智能（Agentspro.cn）推出袋袋（Profy），专家通过对话分享经验即可自动生成数字专家。早期VC Selene和品牌全球化专家宫琼（Joanna）已创建数字分身，将五天尽调流程缩短至两小时，并吸引用户顺着平台找到专家本人签下更高客单价的深度咨询，形成商业闭环。
key_logic_flow: 袋袋（Profy）于5月19日上线，核心模式是让专家通过自然对话分享经验，系统自动将隐性知识封装为可独立交付的数字专家，无需专家学习任何技术框架。
早期风险投资人Selene创建数字分析师后，90%的调用来自有创业念头的普通用户，投资尽调全流程从五天缩短至不到两小时。
品牌全球化专家宫琼（Joanna）创建数字分身后，其专业洞察吸引了出海需求用户，进而顺着平台找到宫琼本人签下更高客单价的全案咨询服务，跑通了从标准化分发到高价值服务的商业闭环。
袋袋的技术护城河由四层构成：多智能体协同编排、隐性知识捕获、意图识别校准、安全边界；架构层设计了IP黑盒保护（核心逻辑在服务端密封运行）和自进化能力（五层认知捕获管线持续优化）。
袋袋在HLE（Humanity's Last Exam）评测中超越基座模型近20个百分点。
袋袋背后团队是未来式智能（Agentspro.cn），在智能体领域已服务过120余家头部企业客户。

articles.title: 腾讯混元开源全新翻译模型Hy-MT2 ，上线小程序「腾讯Hy翻译」
author: [[闻乐]]
articles.description: 最大提升体现在指令遵循能力上
articles.tldr: 腾讯混元开源翻译模型Hy-MT2，上线「腾讯Hy翻译」小程序
articles.objective_summary: 2026年5月21日，腾讯混元开源多语言翻译模型Hy-MT2并上线翻译小程序。模型支持33种语言互译，三个尺寸版本在通用翻译、专业领域和指令遵循任务上均达到开源最佳或接近一流水平，1.8B版本通过极端量化可端侧部署。
key_logic_flow: 2026年5月21日，腾讯混元宣布开源全新翻译模型Hy-MT2并上线翻译小程序「腾讯Hy翻译」。
Hy-MT2包含1.8B、7B、30B-A3B三个尺寸，支持33种语言互译，7B和30B-A3B版本在多项翻译任务上达到开源模型最佳效果，超越几十倍参数量的模型。
基于AngelSlim 1.25-bit极端量化，1.8B版本仅需440MB存储空间，可在主流手机芯片上本地推理，推理速度相比Hy-MT1.5提升1.5倍。
Hy-MT2最大提升在指令遵循能力上，能准确理解并执行用户在术语、风格和格式方面的具体要求，混元同步开源自建评估数据集IFMT Bench。
在真实场景测试集上，Hy-MT2-30B-A3B效果已超过Gemini 3.1 Pro，在金融、政治、教育等垂直领域翻译效果部分超过主流翻译模型。
Hy-MT2已在GitHub、HuggingFace等平台开源，支持ARM、高通、Intel、沐曦、天数智芯等多个硬件平台部署。

articles.title: Five architects of the AI economy explain where the wheels are coming off
author: [[Connie Loizos]]
articles.description: Earlier this week, five people who touch every layer of the AI supply chain sat down at the Milken Global Conference in Beverly Hills, where they talked with TechCrunch about everything from chip shortages to orbital data centers to the possibility that the whole architecture that undergirds the tech is wrong.
articles.tldr: Milken大会五名AI高管讨论芯片短缺、能源瓶颈和AI架构局限
articles.objective_summary: 2026年5月，ASML、Google Cloud、Applied Intuition、Perplexity和Logical Intelligence五家AI产业链公司高管在Milken全球会议上讨论行业瓶颈。各高管指出芯片供应短缺将持续2-5年，能源问题催生轨道数据中心探索，
key_logic_flow: ASML的Fouquet指出芯片制造产能受限，未来2-5年市场将持续供不应求，超大规模云计算厂商无法获得全部已订购芯片。
Google Cloud的deSouza透露该季度营收突破200亿美元（同比增长63%），订单积压从2500亿增至4600亿美元，并确认正在探索轨道数据中心以解决能源瓶颈。
Applied Intuition的Younis表示物理AI的真正瓶颈不是芯片而是真实世界数据，合成数据无法完全替代，同时指出各国对物理形态AI的主权控制意识强烈，能运营无人出租车的国家比拥有核武器的还少。
Logical Intelligence的Bodnia主张能量基模型优于LLM，其200万参数模型运行速度快千倍，无需重新训练即可更新知识，更接近人脑工作原理。
Perplexity的Shevelenko介绍其数字员工产品Comet，强调企业级细粒度权限控制（只读/读写分离）是智能体安全的基础。
中国在DeepSeek等模型层表现优异，但因缺少EUV光刻机无法制造最先进半导体，底层硬件差距将持续制约其AI发展。

articles.title: The Path, founded by Tony Robbins and Calm alums, hopes to offer safer AI therapy
author: [[Julie Bort]]
articles.description: The Path says its AI model has scored 95 on the mental health safety AI benchmark, Vera-MH. This compares to a top score of 65 for the consumer bots.
articles.tldr: The Path 是一家由 Tony Robbins 和 Calm 前员工创立的 AI 心理治疗应用，已融资 1430 万美元。
articles.objective_summary: Anson Whitmer 与 Tyler Sheaffer（均曾任 Calm 早期员工）联合 Tony Robbins 推出 AI 治疗与教练应用 The Path。该应用基于此前男性心理健康应用 Mental 中 AI 音频功能的用户反响而开发，融合 Robbins 的自助方法。
key_logic_flow: Anson Whitmer 和 Tyler Sheaffer 此前在男性心理健康应用 Mental 中发现 AI 交互音频功能深受用户欢迎，由此萌生开发 The Path 的想法。
Tony Robbins 以合伙人的身份加入 Prime Movers Lab 后，与 Whitmer 和 Sheaffer 深入交流并最终成为 The Path 的联合创始人，将该应用定位为治疗与教练结合的产品。
The Path 已完成 1430 万美元种子轮融资，由 Prime Movers Lab 领投，Apolo Anton Ohno、Deontay Wilder 和 Designer Fund 参投。
Whitmer 因亲友自杀经历而攻读心理学博士学位，后加入 Calm，但认为现有产品影响不够大，因而转向 AI 心理健康领域。
Whitmer 认为 LLM 和 AI 可填补心理咨询师数量不足的缺口，实现人人可及的个性化心理健康服务。
Whitmer 指出消费级聊天机器人（如 ChatGPT）被优化用于用户参与度而非治疗效果，这与治疗和教练的目标相悖。

articles.title: Sam Altman makes ‘mic drop’ offer to every Y Combinator startup
author: [[Julie Bort]]
articles.description: Altman offered to have OpenAI invest in every single startup in this Y Combinator class: tokens for equity.
articles.tldr: Sam Altman向YC本届所有169家创业公司提供200万美元OpenAI代币以换取股权
articles.objective_summary: 2026年5月20日，Sam Altman在YC活动中承诺向本届约169家创业公司每家提供价值200万美元的OpenAI代币，以无上限SAFE形式在首次定价融资轮中转换为股权。此举意在鼓励创业公司使用OpenAI而非其竞争对手Anthropic。
key_logic_flow: Sam Altman在YC活动上向本届约169家创业公司每家提供价值200万美元的OpenAI代币以换取股权。
该交易以无上限SAFE（简单未来股权协议）形式进行，将在创业公司首次定价融资轮（通常是A轮）时按估值转换为股权。
若创业公司估值达1亿美元，OpenAI预计可获得约2%股权，但具体条款尚未公开验证。
对OpenAI而言，此举既可获得初创公司股权收益，又能锁定创业公司使用其平台而非Anthropic等竞争对手。
支持者认为该交易可消除早期创业公司最大的AI基础设施成本负担；批评者如Jason Calacanis警告OpenAI可能通过代币使用数据复制创业公司创意。

articles.title: Anthropic will pay xAI $1.25B per month for compute
author: [[Tim De Chant]]
articles.description: Elon Musk's xAI surprised the AI world when it made a deal to sell compute to Anthropic. Now we know how much it's worth.
articles.tldr: Anthropic 以每月 12.5 亿美元向 xAI 购买算力至 2029 年
articles.objective_summary: SpaceX 的 SEC 文件披露，Anthropic 将以每月 12.5 亿美元向 xAI 购买 Colossus 1 数据中心 300 兆瓦算力，合同持续至 2029 年 5 月，总金额超 400 亿美元。
key_logic_flow: Anthropic 与 xAI 达成协议，以每月 12.5 亿美元购买 Colossus 1 数据中心 300 兆瓦的全部算力，合同持续至 2029 年 5 月，首两月享受折扣价。
SpaceX 在 SEC 的 S-1 文件中披露了该交易，该合同可为 xAI 带来超 400 亿美元收入，双方均可提前 90 天通知终止合同。
xAI 采用 "neocloud" 混合模式，既自建数据中心自用，又将闲置算力出售给他人，以抵消基础设施投资成本。
xAI 的 Grok 使用量近期大幅下降，释放出的服务器容量被出售给竞争对手 Anthropic，SpaceX 表示计划签署更多类似合同。

articles.title: China's Moonshot AI raises $2B at $20B valuation as demand for open-source AI skyrockets
author: [[Kate Park]]
articles.description: Moonshot's annualized recurring revenue topped $200 million in April, driven by rapid growth in paid subscriptions and API usage.
articles.tldr: 月之暗面以200亿美元估值融资20亿美元，由美团龙珠资本领投
articles.objective_summary: 北京AI实验室月之暗面（Moonshot AI）以200亿美元估值完成约20亿美元融资，由美团旗下龙珠资本领投，清华控股、中国移动、CPE源峰等参投。过去六个月累计融资39亿美元，估值从2025年底的43亿美元飙升至200亿美元。公司2026年4月ARR突破2亿美元。
key_logic_flow: 月之暗面（Moonshot AI）以200亿美元估值完成约20亿美元融资，由美团旗下龙珠资本领投，清华控股、中国移动、CPE源峰等参投。
过去六个月内，Moonshot AI累计融资39亿美元，估值从2025年底的43亿美元飙升至200亿美元。
Moonshot AI由前Meta AI和Google Brain研究员杨植麟于2023年创立，其开源模型Kimi K2.5在编码基准测试中表现接近OpenAI和Anthropic的同期模型水平。
Moonshot AI最新模型Kimi K2.6在分发平台OpenRouter上成为使用量第二大的LLM。
2026年4月，Moonshot AI年度经常性收入（ARR）突破2亿美元，主要受付费订阅和API使用量快速增长驱动。

articles.title: IrisGo, a startup backed by Andrew Ng, looks to become the AI desktop buddy you never knew you needed
author: [[Lucas Ropek]]
articles.description: Initially billed as an "AI butler," Iris watches what happens on a user's desktop and automatically learns how to do tasks for them, its co-founder says.
articles.tldr: Andrew Ng 投资的 IrisGo 推出 AI 桌面伴侣，可学习用户工作流并自动执行重复任务。
articles.objective_summary: IrisGo 是一家由 Andrew Ng 的 AI Fund 投资的初创公司，已完成 280 万美元种子轮融资。该公司推出了一款 PC 桌面伴侣应用，通过录制用户操作来学习工作流并能自动执行，同时内置技能库和编程助手功能，采用本地与云端混合架构。
key_logic_flow: IrisGo 由前 Apple 工程师 Jeffrey Lai 联合创立，获得了 Andrew Ng 旗下 AI Fund 的 280 万美元种子轮投资，公司名 Iris 是 Siri 的反向拼写。
该应用是一款 PC 桌面伴侣软件，通过录制用户操作一次即可记住整个流程，之后无需重复指令即可自动执行。
IrisGo 内置「技能库」，涵盖邮件起草、发票处理、报告生成、文档摘要等预置自动化工作流，并会从用户桌面行为中自动学习新增潜在可自动化任务。
该应用还包含一个编程助手功能，概念上类似于 OpenAI Codex 或 Anthropic Claude Code，辅助开发人员工作。
IrisGo 采用混合架构：大部分数据在本地设备处理以保护隐私，复杂任务经用户明确授权后通过云端处理并使用端到端加密。
产品目标用户为白领知识工作者，旨在将重复性办公任务自动化，让用户专注于高层次的创造性工作。

该协议于 2025 年 11 月宣布，Perplexity 计划以现金加股权方式支付 Snap 4 亿美元，将 AI 搜索引擎集成到 Snapchat 的聊天界面中。

articles.title: Hark raises $700M Series A for its secretive ‘universal’ AI interface
author: [[Tim Fernholz]]
articles.description: Hark expects to release its first multimodal models this summer, which it says will power a personal AI platform that works with existing products and services. The company expects to follow that with hardware devices built specifically for those systems.
articles.tldr: Hark以60亿美元估值完成7亿美元A轮融资，打造通用AI个人助理
articles.objective_summary: Hark于2026年5月21日宣布完成7亿美元A轮融资，投后估值60亿美元，由Parkway Venture Capital领投，Nvidia、AMD Ventures、Intel Capital、Qualcomm Ventures、Salesforce Ventures等参投。
key_logic_flow: Hark宣布完成7亿美元A轮融资，投后估值60亿美元，由Parkway Venture Capital领投，Nvidia、AMD Ventures、Intel Capital、Qualcomm Ventures、Salesforce Ventures等多家机构参投。
创始人兼CEO Brett Adcock于2025年末自掏1亿美元创立Hark，目标是开发作为数字世界通用接口的代理AI系统。
Hark计划今年夏天发布首批多模态模型，用于驱动个人AI平台，随后推出配套的专用硬件设备。
新资金将用于招募硬件、产品设计和AI研究领域的高端人才，以及获取算力和组件；公司目前有70名员工，运营着配备Nvidia B200 GPU的数据中心。
前苹果产品高管Abidur Chowdhury担任Hark设计总监，他批评当前AI产品主要面向开发者而非普通消费者，而Hark专注于构建面向大众的界面和原生硬件。

articles.title: Six search engines worth trying now that Google isn’t really Google anymore

articles.tldr: Google I/O 2026宣布搜索全面AI化，用户不满并转向Kagi等替代引擎。
articles.objective_summary: Google在I/O 2026上宣布对搜索进行最大规模AI改造，推出AI模式和聊天界面替代传统搜索框。用户反应负面，认为这是AI过度植入的又一例证。文章介绍了Kagi等替代搜索方案。
key_logic_flow: Google在I/O 2026上宣布搜索全面AI化，推出AI模式和聊天式交互界面，Elizabeth Reid称这是25年来搜索框的最大升级。
用户对Google搜索AI化反应负面，此前AI Overviews曾出现推荐"凝视太阳"等错误信息，加剧了不信任。
2024年美国联邦法院裁定Google在搜索市场存在非法垄断行为，成为用户寻求替代方案的另一动因。
Kagi以每月5-10美元的无广告订阅模式运营，不提供AI概览，作为Google的替代方案被推荐。
Kagi允许用户通过"lenses"透镜功能自定义搜索体验，如学术透镜可过滤到学术论文而非博客文章。

articles.title: Barry Diller trusts Sam Altman. But 'trust is irrelevant' as AGI nears, he says.
author: [[Sarah Perez]]
articles.description: Barry Diller defended OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, while warning that AGI remains an unpredictable force needing guardrails.
articles.tldr: Barry Diller称信任Sam Altman，但AGI的未知后果让信任无关紧要
articles.objective_summary: 媒体大亨Barry Diller在WSJ"Future of Everything"会议上为Sam Altman辩护，称其真诚且有良好价值观；但他认为随着AGI逼近，信任问题已无关紧要，真正风险在于AI创造的未知后果，人类必须设置护栏，否则AGI将自行其是且不可逆转。
key_logic_flow: Barry Diller在WSJ会议上公开为Sam Altman辩护，称其是真诚且价值观端正的人，回应了外界对Altman可信度的质疑。
Diller认为随着AGI临近，信任问题已变得无关紧要，因为真正的风险在于AI带来的未知后果，连创造者本身也无法完全预知。
Diller指出AI的进展虽被充分报道，但其最终结果充满不确定性，创造者们自身也对此感到惊奇。
Diller警告必须提前为AGI设置护栏，否则AGI力量将自行其是，一旦超越人类控制将不可逆转。

articles.title: Microsoft’s carbon-removal plans aren’t dead after all
